literature.headline_zh: 登革病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期登革病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 总共报告了 138,885 例病例和 14 例死亡。年龄标准化的 发病率 显着增加(AAPC:+30.1%)。高风险 I 类地区占全国负担的 87.1%,尽管其他低风险地区在特定成年男性亚群中表现出加速的 发病率。 [10.1186/s40249-026-01516-8]
我们的研究结果揭示了抗体介导的中和和增强中的基因型特异性变异,强调了抗体反应和 DENV 遗传多样性之间复杂的相互作用。 [10.1128/spectrum.00723-26]
值得注意的是,与未佐剂的 EDIII mRNA 疫苗 相比,新型 bis-mZDV 的中和抗体滴度提高了 8 倍。更重要的是,在免疫缺陷小鼠中,它可以针对 ZIKV 和 DENV 攻击提供保护,并引发强大的体液和细胞 免疫应答。 [10.1080/22221751.2026.2762582]

FPR 第 1 天将严重程度组分开,AUC 0.704 (95% CI 0.579-0.830);重症患者的中位 FPR 是非重症患者的五倍(39.0 vs 7.5;p = 0.001)。针对休克/DSS,FPR 第 1 天的 AUC 为 0.789,严重血小板减少症的 AUC 为 0.727。FLR 第 1 天区分严重肝炎的 AUC 为 0.995(95% CI 0.988-1.000),不高于单独的 ALT(AUC 1.000;DeLong p = 0.23)。 [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014867]
在拉丁美洲和亚太地区均观察到所有四种DENV血清型的共循环现象。DENV-1是最主要的血清型(51.1%),其基因型分布存在显著的地理差异。研究发现2023–2024年间拉丁美洲地区DENV-3和DENV-4毒株的传播增加。 [10.1038/s41598-026-78886-4]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: A total of 138,885 cases and 14 deaths were reported. The age-standardized incidence increased significantly (AAPC: +30.1%). High-risk category I regions accounted for 87.1% of the national burden, though other low-risk regions exhibited accelerating incidence among specific adult male subgroups. [10.1186/s40249-026-01516-8]

Our findings reveal genotype-specific variations in antibody-mediated neutralization and enhancement, emphasizing the complex interplay between antibody responses and DENV genetic diversity. [10.1128/spectrum.00723-26]

Notably, the new bis-mZDV achieved up to an 8-fold enhancement in neutralizing antibody titers compared to the unadjuvanted EDIII mRNA vaccine. More importantly, in immunodeficient mice, it conferred protection against both ZIKV and DENV challenges and elicited robust humoral and cellular immune responses. [10.1080/22221751.2026.2762582]

FPR Day 1 separated the severity groups with AUC 0.704 (95% CI 0.579-0.830); severe patients showed five-fold higher median FPR than non-severe patients (39.0 vs 7.5; p = 0.001). Against shock/DSS, FPR Day 1 had AUC 0.789 and severe thrombocytopenia with AUC 0.727. [10.1371/journal.pntd.0014867]

Cocirculation of all four DENV serotypes was observed in both Latin America and Asia-Pacific regions. DENV-1 was the predominant serotype (51.1%), with significant geographical variations in genotype distribution. Increased circulation of DENV-3 and DENV-4 strains was identified in Latin America during 2023–2024. [10.1038/s41598-026-78886-4]

The age-standardized incidence increased significantly (AAPC: +30.1%). Our findings reveal genotype-specific variations in antibody-mediated neutralization and enhancement, emphasizing the complex interplay between antibody responses and DENV genetic diversity. [10.1128/spectrum.00723-26]. Notably, the new bis-mZDV achieved up to an 8-fold enhancement in neutralizing antibody titers compared to the unadjuvanted EDIII mRNA vaccine. news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Dengue virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Dengue fever outbreak; cases and hospitalizations reported. [news-c6600fe3739bbfb1]

Dengue fever cases are increasing, with over 170,000 cases reported in the first 10 months of 2026, a 26% rise compared to the same period in 2025. The disease is now occurring year-round in many localities, including some mountainous provinces in the North. [news-236220c981877370]

A narrative review of dengue virus literature published between 2000 and 2026 establishes that disease severity is driven primarily by host immune reactions rather than viral replication alone. [news-4a53c23ff3696ec9]

Dengue fever cases exceeded 170,000 in the first 10 months of 2026, with 21 deaths, and experts warned about the disease's increasing complexity and challenges in prevention and control. [news-ae1f7caa166e2f89]
Dengue fever cases exceeded 170,000 in Vietnam, and experts warned that mosquito eradication alone is insufficient (N1, N2, N10). [news-fae9c5b088415948]

papers.title: The rapidly growing burden of dengue fever in China from 2005 to 2024: spatiotemporal patterns and age-sex-specific disparities in incidence and disability-adjusted life years.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Dengue fever has transitioned from a sporadic imported infection to an established domestic threat in China, challenging the conventional view of its non-endemic status. Understanding its evolving epidemiological landscape over the past two decades is critical for evidence-based intervention planning. Methods We analyzed national notifiable dengue surveillance data from 2005 to 2024. Temporal trends were assessed using Joinpoint regression to estimate average annual percent changes (AAPC) in incidence, stratified by age, sex, and province, with particular focus on Guangdong and Yunnan. Spatial heterogeneity was characterized through standardized provincial incidence mapping. Disease burden was quantified using disability-adjusted life years (DALYs), incorporating years of life lost and years lived with disability, based on locally derived severity distributions and disability weights. Results A total of 138,885 cases and 14 deaths were reported. Annual case counts rose sharply from 40 to 24,278, with major epidemic peaks in 2014, 2019, 2023, and 2024. The age-standardized incidence increased significantly (AAPC: + 30.1%). Adults aged 25–49 years constituted 49.2% of all cases, yet the steepest relative increases occurred among children aged 0–9 years (male AAPC + 32.7%, female + 35.4%) and adults aged ≥ 70 years (male + 43.3%, female + 39.6%). High-risk category I regions accounted for 87.1% of the national burden, though other low-risk regions exhibited accelerating incidence among specific adult male subgroups. Total DALYs reached 2206.9 person-years (age-standardized rate: 0.0744 per million), predominantly driven by YLD and concentrated in the working-age population (79.5%). Conclusions Dengue in China has entered a phase of rapid burden escalation with widening demographic and geographic reach. While the working-age population bears the largest absolute burden, children and older adults face the fastest-rising risk. These findings underscore the urgency of transitioning from reactive outbreak response to precision public health, integrating age-targeted interventions, regionally stratified surveillance, and serological monitoring within a One Health framework to inform future vaccine deployment.

analysis_zh.methods: 通过标准化的省级 发病率 制图来表征空间异质性。根据当地得出的严重程度分布和残疾权重,使用残疾调整生命年(DALY)来量化疾病负担,其中包括生命损失年数和残疾生存年数。
analysis_zh.main_results: 总共报告了 138,885 例病例和 14 例死亡。年龄标准化的 发病率 显着增加(AAPC:+30.1%)。高风险 I 类地区占全国负担的 87.1%,尽管其他低风险地区在特定成年男性亚群中表现出加速的 发病率。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现强调了从反应性 暴发 响应过渡到精准公共卫生的紧迫性,整合针对年龄的干预措施、区域分层的 监测 以及 One Health 框架内的血清学监测,为未来的 疫苗 部署提供信息。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 劳动年龄人口承受着最大的绝对负担,而儿童和老年人则面临着上升最快的风险。DALY 总数达到 2206.9 人年(年龄标准化率:0.0744/百万),主要由 YLD 驱动,集中在工作年龄人口(79.5%)。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据并未报告研究设计或数据收集方法的具体限制。证据强度中等,因为研究结果基于 监测 数据和回归分析,这在捕获真实疾病负担方面可能具有固有的局限性。

papers.title: CD8+ T cells and humoral immunity may mitigate the effects of antibody-dependent enhancement: implications for dengue vaccine design.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue vaccine development is complicated by antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE)—a phenomenon in which antibodies paradoxically boost viral growth. Signals of immune-mediated enhancement were observed in the CYD-TDV (Dengvaxia) vaccine trials, but have not yet been reported for trials of TAK-003 (Qdenga). To better understand how prior immunity influences dengue infection outcomes, we developed a mechanistic within-host model of acute dengue infection dynamics that incorporates ADE as well as humoral and CD8+ T-cell immunity. Model simulations illustrate a potentially very important difference between enhancement by antibody, enhancement by humoral immunity, and enhanced severity of secondary infection. Model results also suggest that recipients of CYD-TDV may have been more likely to experience immune-mediated enhancement because of its yellow fever virus backbone and corresponding lack of dengue-specific CD8+ T-cell epitopes. The model provides a possible explanation for differences in reported outcomes of dengue vaccine trials and suggests incorporating DENV backbones from all four serotypes as a potentially promising way forward in the design of future dengue vaccines. IMPORTANCE Vaccines are typically designed to elicit humoral (antibody-mediated) immunity, and antibody titers are commonly used as correlates of protection. Because CD8+ T-cell responses are more challenging to measure, they are not typically used as correlates of protection and have received comparatively less attention. For viruses such as dengue, where antibodies may increase viral replication and thus the risk of severe disease through antibody-dependent enhancement, it is necessary to understand how humoral and cellular immunity interact during infection. Our model suggests that low antibody levels can enhance viral replication but that this effect can be mitigated by humoral and CD8+ T-cell immunity. This result offers a hypothesis to explain the observed differences in outcomes between the CYD-TDV and TAK-003 trials and suggests that evaluating CD8+ T-cell responses alongside antibody titers may be important for designing and assessing the safety and efficacy of future dengue vaccines.

papers.title: Comprehensive profiling of genotype-specific dengue antibody responses using a newly developed single-round infectious particle panel.
papers.abstract: UNLABELLED: Neutralizing antibodies provide critical protection against dengue virus (DENV) infections. However, under certain conditions, antibodies can also enhance infection and contribute to severe disease through antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). ADE can occur through extrinsic mechanisms, in which antibody-opsonized virions engage with Fcγ receptors (FcγRs) on target cells to facilitate increased viral entry, while intrinsic mechanisms have been proposed in which FcγR-mediated uptake triggers intracellular pathways that promote viral replication. The extensive genetic diversity of DENV further complicates the evaluation of antibody functionality, as antibodies may exhibit distinct neutralizing and enhancing activities against different viral genotypes. Here, we developed a single-round infectious particle (SRIP) panel representing 17 DENV genotypes across all four DENV serotypes. This genotype-inclusive platform enables assessment of antibody-mediated neutralization and FcγR-dependent enhancement of infection through luciferase reporter quantification. Using this panel, we evaluated antibody responses from DENV-infected individuals, healthy volunteers, and flavivirus-cross-reactive or DENV-specific monoclonal antibodies. Our findings reveal genotype-specific variations in antibody-mediated neutralization and enhancement, emphasizing the complex interplay between antibody responses and DENV genetic diversity. This SRIP panel provides a robust approach for profiling functional antibodies against genetically diverse DENV strains. While the current platform primarily quantifies extrinsic ADE, its single-round infection format and intracellular replicon-based readout provide a foundation for future investigations of intrinsic ADE mechanisms. Overall, this platform offers broad applications for studying dengue immunity, evaluating vaccine-induced antibody responses, and advancing our understanding of antibody-mediated protection and disease enhancement. IMPORTANCE: Dengue virus (DENV) comprises four serotypes and substantial genetic diversity, which can influence the ability of antibodies to neutralize or enhance infection. However, comparative assessment of antibody functionality across diverse DENV genotypes remains challenging because differences in viral genetic backgrounds can confound functional measurements. We developed a single-round infectious particle (SRIP) panel representing 17 DENV genotypes in which the prM and E structural proteins are varied on a common replicon backbone. This design provides a standardized platform for directly comparing antibody-mediated neutralization and Fcγ receptor-dependent enhancement across genetically diverse DENV strains. By characterizing antibody responses against a broad range of genotypes, the panel can reveal differences in functional antibody activity that may be overlooked when using a limited number of representative strains. The platform is therefore useful for investigating how DENV genetic diversity influences antibody-mediated protection and extrinsic antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), as well as for evaluating the breadth of antibody responses induced by infection or vaccination. Although the current platform primarily quantifies extrinsic ADE, its single-round infection format and quantitative intracellular reporter readout provide a foundation for future studies investigating intrinsic ADE in more physiologically relevant immune cell models. This genotype-inclusive panel offers a practical approach for standardized functional profiling of dengue antibodies and may facilitate improved evaluation of vaccine-induced immunity and antibody responses across the genetic diversity of DENV.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to address the challenge of evaluating antibody functionality against diverse dengue virus (DENV) genotypes. The researchers developed a single-round infectious particle (SRIP) panel representing 17 DENV genotypes across all four serotypes, enabling standardized assessment of neutralization and FcγR-dependent enhancement. By characterizing antibody responses against a broad range of genotypes, the panel revealed genotype-specific variations in neutralization and enhancement, highlighting the complex relationship between antibody responses and DENV genetic diversity. While the current platform primarily quantifies extrinsic ADE, its design provides a foundation for future investigations into intrinsic ADE mechanisms. The study underscores the importance of considering DENV genetic diversity in assessing antibody-mediated protection and disease enhancement.

papers.title_zh: 使用新开发的单轮感染性颗粒组对基因型特异性登革热抗体反应进行全面分析。
papers.source_body_en: UNLABELLED: Neutralizing antibodies provide critical protection against dengue virus (DENV) infections. However, under certain conditions, antibodies can also enhance infection and contribute to severe disease through antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE). ADE can occur through extrinsic mechanisms, in which antibody-opsonized virions engage with Fcγ receptors (FcγRs) on target cells to facilitate increased viral entry, while intrinsic mechanisms have been proposed in which FcγR-mediated uptake triggers intracellular pathways that promote viral replication. The extensive genetic diversity of DENV further complicates the evaluation of antibody functionality, as antibodies may exhibit distinct neutralizing and enhancing activities against different viral genotypes. Here, we developed a single-round infectious particle (SRIP) panel representing 17 DENV genotypes across all four DENV serotypes. This genotype-inclusive platform enables assessment of antibody-mediated neutralization and FcγR-dependent enhancement of infection through luciferase reporter quantification. Using this panel, we evaluated antibody responses from DENV-infected individuals, healthy volunteers, and flavivirus-cross-reactive or DENV-specific monoclonal antibodies. Our findings reveal genotype-specific variations in antibody-mediated neutralization and enhancement, emphasizing the complex interplay between antibody responses and DENV genetic diversity. This SRIP panel provides a robust approach for profiling functional antibodies against genetically diverse DENV strains. While the current platform primarily quantifies extrinsic ADE, its single-round infection format and intracellular replicon-based readout provide a foundation for future investigations of intrinsic ADE mechanisms. Overall, this platform offers broad applications for studying dengue immunity, evaluating vaccine-induced antibody responses, and advancing our understanding of antibody-mediated protection and disease enhancement. IMPORTANCE: Dengue virus (DENV) comprises four serotypes and substantial genetic diversity, which can influence the ability of antibodies to neutralize or enhance infection. However, comparative assessment of antibody functionality across diverse DENV genotypes remains challenging because differences in viral genetic backgrounds can confound functional measurements. We developed a single-round infectious particle (SRIP) panel representing 17 DENV genotypes in which the prM and E structural proteins are varied on a common replicon backbone. This design provides a standardized platform for directly comparing antibody-mediated neutralization and Fcγ receptor-dependent enhancement across genetically diverse DENV strains. By characterizing antibody responses against a broad range of genotypes, the panel can reveal differences in functional antibody activity that may be overlooked when using a limited number of representative strains. The platform is therefore useful for investigating how DENV genetic diversity influences antibody-mediated protection and extrinsic antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), as well as for evaluating the breadth of antibody responses induced by infection or vaccination. Although the current platform primarily quantifies extrinsic ADE, its single-round infection format and quantitative intracellular reporter readout provide a foundation for future studies investigating intrinsic ADE in more physiologically relevant immune cell models. This genotype-inclusive panel offers a practical approach for standardized functional profiling of dengue antibodies and may facilitate improved evaluation of vaccine-induced immunity and antibody responses across the genetic diversity of DENV.
papers.abstract_zh: 未标记:中和抗体提供针对 登革病毒 (DENV) 感染的关键保护。然而,在某些条件下,抗体也可以通过 抗体依赖性增强 (ADE) 增强感染并导致严重疾病。ADE 可以通过外在机制发生,其中抗体调理的病毒粒子与靶细胞上的 Fcγ 受体 (FcγR) 结合,以促进病毒进入增加,而内在机制中,FcγR 介导的摄取触发促进病毒复制的细胞内途径。DENV 广泛的遗传多样性使抗体功能的评估进一步复杂化,因为抗体可能对不同的病毒基因型表现出不同的中和和增强活性。在这里,我们开发了一个单轮感染性颗粒 (SRIP) 组合,代表所有四种 DENV 血清型中的 17 种 DENV 基因型。这个包含基因型的平台能够通过荧光素酶报告定量来评估抗体介导的中和和 FcγR 依赖性感染增强。使用该面板,我们评估了 DENV 感染者、健康志愿者以及黄病毒交叉反应或 DENV 特异性单克隆抗体的抗体反应。我们的研究结果揭示了抗体介导的中和和增强中的基因型特异性变异,强调了抗体反应和 DENV 遗传多样性之间复杂的相互作用。该 SRIP panel 提供了一种强大的方法来分析针对遗传多样性 DENV 毒株的功能性抗体。虽然当前平台主要量化外在 ADE,但其单轮感染格式和基于细胞内复制子的读出为未来研究内在 ADE 机制奠定了基础。总体而言,该平台为研究登革热免疫、评估 疫苗 诱导的抗体反应以及增进我们对抗体介导的保护和疾病增强的理解提供了广泛的应用。重要性:登革病毒 (DENV) 包含四种血清型和大量的遗传多样性,可以影响抗体中和或增强感染的能力。然而,对不同 DENV 基因型的抗体功能进行比较评估仍然具有挑战性,因为病毒遗传背景的差异可能会混淆功能测量。我们开发了代表 17 种 DENV 基因型的单轮感染性颗粒 (SRIP) 组合,其中 prM 和 E 结构蛋白在共同的复制子骨架上有所不同。该设计提供了一个标准化平台,用于直接比较遗传多样性 DENV 毒株中抗体介导的中和作用和 Fcγ 受体依赖性增强作用。通过表征针对广泛基因型的抗体反应,该小组可以揭示功能性抗体活性的差异,而在使用有限数量的代表性菌株时,这些差异可能会被忽视。因此,该平台可用于研究 DENV 遗传多样性如何影响抗体介导的保护和外在 抗体依赖性增强 (ADE),以及评估感染或 疫苗接种 诱导的抗体反应的广度。尽管当前平台主要量化外在 ADE,但其单轮感染形式和定量细胞内报告基因读数为未来在更多生理相关免疫细胞模型中研究内在 ADE 的研究奠定了基础。这种包含基因型的面板为登革热抗体的标准化功能分析提供了一种实用方法,并可能有助于改进对 疫苗 诱导的免疫和跨 DENV 遗传多样性的抗体反应的评估。

papers.title: Targeting CLK1 by CRISPR tools and pharmacological inhibition modulates the innate immune response and dengue virus replication.
papers.abstract: Alternative splicing is a key regulatory mechanism known to be altered upon viral infection. These alterations can arise both from direct viral interference with the splicing machinery and from cellular responses such as activation of innate immunity. Here, we investigated splicing changes shared between dengue virus (DENV) infection and interferon (IFN) treatment in cultured cells, the latter serving as a model for virus-independent innate immune activation. Among the common events, we identified an increased production of non-coding mRNA isoforms from the CLK1 gene, which gives rise to a kinase that phosphorylates splicing factors including SR proteins and spliceosomal components. Consistent with this finding, IFN treatment led to a reduction in CLK1 protein levels. Using stable cell lines with CRISPR/dCas9-mediated modulation of CLK1 expression, we found that silencing CLK1 enhanced the induction of immune response genes, while its overexpression attenuated it. Inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with the pharmacological inhibitor TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication. Altogether, these results identify CLK1 as a proviral negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression and suggest that its inhibition could enhance antiviral defenses and become a target for therapeutic strategies.

papers.title_zh: 通过 CRISPR 工具和药理抑制来靶向 CLK1 可调节先天的 免疫应答 和 登革病毒 复制。
papers.source_body_en: Alternative splicing is a key regulatory mechanism known to be altered upon viral infection. These alterations can arise both from direct viral interference with the splicing machinery and from cellular responses such as activation of innate immunity. Here, we investigated splicing changes shared between dengue virus (DENV) infection and interferon (IFN) treatment in cultured cells, the latter serving as a model for virus-independent innate immune activation. Among the common events, we identified an increased production of non-coding mRNA isoforms from the CLK1 gene, which gives rise to a kinase that phosphorylates splicing factors including SR proteins and spliceosomal components. Consistent with this finding, IFN treatment led to a reduction in CLK1 protein levels. Using stable cell lines with CRISPR/dCas9-mediated modulation of CLK1 expression, we found that silencing CLK1 enhanced the induction of immune response genes, while its overexpression attenuated it. Inhibition of CLK1 kinase activity with the pharmacological inhibitor TG003 further potentiated IFN-induced gene expression and reduced DENV replication. Altogether, these results identify CLK1 as a proviral negative regulator of IFN-stimulated gene expression and suggest that its inhibition could enhance antiviral defenses and become a target for therapeutic strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 选择性剪接是已知在病毒感染时发生改变的关键调节机制。这些改变可能来自病毒对剪接机制的直接干扰,也可能来自细胞反应,例如先天免疫的激活。在这里,我们研究了培养细胞中 登革病毒 (DENV) 感染和干扰素 (IFN) 治疗 之间共享的剪接变化,后者作为病毒依赖性先天免疫激活的模型。在常见事件中,我们发现 CLK1 基因非编码 mRNA 亚型的产量增加,从而产生一种磷酸化剪接因子(包括 SR 蛋白和剪接体成分)的激酶。与这一发现一致,IFN 治疗 导致 CLK1 蛋白水平降低。使用具有 CRISPR/dCas9 介导的 CLK1 表达调节的稳定细胞系,我们发现沉默 CLK1 增强了 免疫应答 基因的诱导,而其过度表达则减弱了这种诱导。用药理学抑制剂 TG003 抑制 CLK1 激酶活性,进一步增强 IFN 诱导的基因表达并减少 DENV 复制。总而言之,这些结果确定 CLK1 是 IFN 刺激的基因表达的前病毒负调节因子,并表明其抑制可以增强 抗病毒药物 防御并成为治疗策略的目标。

papers.title: Trends and Patterns of Dengue Incidence and Mortality in Bangladesh: A Re-Emerging Public Health Issue.
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background Bangladesh faced a rapid dengue outbreak in its history after the year 2020 which marked as a re‐emerging health issue. This study aims to assess the significant change of the trends and patterns of dengue incidence and mortality over the year from 2000 to 2025 in Bangladesh. Methods The publicly available government data were used from the Management Information System of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Bangladesh, from 2000 to 2025. The data were cleaned, coded, and a descriptive analysis was performed using the Microsoft Excel. For assessing the significant trend of dengue cases, deaths, and case fatality rate (CFR), the Mann–Kendall test and Sen's slope estimator were conducted using the RStudio version 4.6.0 software. Moreover, Joinpoint regression software was used to analyze the temporal trends of dengue cases and deaths with p value less than 0.05 considered statistically significant. Results According to the findings, the highest dengue record cases and deaths were reported in 2023 where 321,179 cases and 1705 deaths occurred as highest in the history of Bangladesh. Females and the elderly were most vulnerable in 2023 and other years as well. The CFR was high among the older population aged 61+, as highest in 2024. Most of the dengue cases and deaths occurred from July to December. The dengue cases and deaths significantly increased over the year from 2000 to 2025. But the CFR was not statistically significant over the year. Conclusion Dengue significantly increased over the year and has become more fatal since 2020. More effective strategies are needed to prevent and control the exposure of cases and deaths of dengue. The policy suggests to enhancing the awareness programs for preventing dengue exposure and strengthening the health system capacity for government.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 2020 年之后,孟加拉国面临历史上一次快速登革热 暴发,这标志着它成为一个重新出现的健康问题。本研究旨在评估2000年至2025年孟加拉国登革热发病率和死亡率的趋势和模式的显着变化。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究使用了孟加拉国卫生和家庭福利部管理信息系统中 2000 年至 2025 年的公开政府数据。数据经过清理、编码,并使用 Microsoft Excel 进行了描述性分析。
elements_zh.methods: 为了评估登革热病例、死亡和病死率 (CFR) 的显着趋势,使用 RStudio 4.6.0 版软件进行了 Mann-Kendall 检验和 Sen 斜率估计器。此外,使用Joinpoint回归软件分析登革热病例和死亡的时间趋势,p值小于0.05被认为具有统计显着性。
elements_zh.main_results: 调查结果显示,2023 年报告了登革热病例和死亡人数最高记录,其中 321,179 例病例和 1705 人死亡,为孟加拉国历史最高记录。2000年至2025年,登革热病例和死亡人数显着增加。病死率逐年没有统计显着性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,登革热在过去一年中显着增加,并且自 2020 年以来变得更加致命。这项研究为孟加拉国登革热 发病率 和 死亡率 的时间趋势和模式提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明需要采取更有效的策略来预防和控制登革热病例和死亡的暴露。该政策建议加强预防登革热暴露的意识计划,并加强政府卫生系统的能力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于公开的政府数据,这些数据在完整性或准确性方面可能存在局限性。证据是中等的,因为它基于描述性分析和统计测试,没有详细的实验室或临床验证。

papers.title: A bispecific mRNA vaccine against zika and dengue viruses to overcome antibody-dependent enhancement and provide protection in preclinical models.
papers.abstract: Zika virus (ZIKV) and dengue virus (DENV) are two widespread flaviviruses that pose a significant threat to public health. Owing to their extensive co-circulation and antigenic cross-reactivity, both viruses carry the risk of antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE), a phenomenon that renders existing vaccines unable to simultaneously protect against both pathogens. To overcome this limitation, we developed a bispecific mRNA vaccine against ZIKV and DENV (bis-mZDV) by integrating orthogonal B-cell and T-cell modules. The B-cell module was constructed by fusing ZIKV EDIII to the self-adjuvanting complement component C3d to enhance neutralizing antibody titers. The T-cell module incorporated conserved epitopes from ZIKV and DENV, thereby inducing cross-reactive CD8+ T cells without eliciting ADE-prone B-cell responses. Notably, the new bis-mZDV achieved up to an 8-fold enhancement in neutralizing antibody titers compared to the unadjuvanted EDIII mRNA vaccine. More importantly, in immunodeficient mice, it conferred protection against both ZIKV and DENV challenges and elicited robust humoral and cellular immune responses. The bis-mZDV represents a promising strategy that may be applicable to co-circulating pathogens and other viruses associated with ADE.

papers.title: Bifurcation analysis and optimal control of a Dengue fever model with saturated nonlinear incidence and dual time delays
papers.abstract: Dengue fever remains a serious public health challenge, and mathematical models offer a valuable lens for understanding its dynamics and guiding control efforts. This study develops and analyses a seven-compartment deterministic model that links human and mosquito populations through coupled transmission pathways. The model incorporates several features not previously combined in the dengue literature: a saturated incidence function that captures crowding effects in both transmission directions, two biologically distinct incubation delays representing the time the virus spends in humans and in mosquitoes separately, gradual loss of temporary immunity after recovery, and a three-component optimal control framework. The threshold quantity governing outbreak potential is derived and estimated at approximately 2.37 under baseline conditions. When this threshold falls to or below one, the disease-free equilibrium is shown to be globally asymptotically stable; when it exceeds one, a unique endemic equilibrium emerges; its local asymptotic stability is established analytically for the full DDE model, and global stability is proved for the limiting ODE case (no delays, no saturation, no waning immunity). A notable finding is that the system can sustain endemic transmission even when the threshold is driven below one, provided that the saturation constant satisfies α > α † and the waning immunity rate δ h > 0 act together—a result with direct implications for eradication strategies. Analysis of the incubation delay reveals that beyond a critical value of roughly 9.4 days, the system transitions into sustained oscillations, offering a mechanistic explanation for the seasonal cycles commonly observed in Southeast Asian dengue data. Sensitivity analysis highlights mosquito mortality as the most influential parameter. Optimal control solutions, derived analytically, point to combined intervention strategies as substantially more effective than single-measure approaches. Numerical simulations validate all theoretical results.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a mathematical model of dengue fever that incorporates a saturated nonlinear incidence function, dual time delays for human and mosquito incubation, and waning immunity. The model derives a threshold quantity for outbreak potential, estimated at 2.37 under baseline conditions. It demonstrates that disease-free equilibrium is globally stable when the threshold is below one, while an endemic equilibrium emerges when it exceeds one. The study contributes to understanding dengue dynamics and informs public health strategies for control and eradication.

papers.title: Variation among dengue virus-1 lineages affects the neutralization breadth of antibody responses elicited by infection and vaccination
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue virus (DENV) genetic diversity within serotypes may influence the breadth and durability of vaccine-induced immunity. We developed a panel of DENV-1 reporter virus particles encompassing ~ 74% of known global envelope protein diversity and evaluated neutralization using sera from tetravalent vaccine recipients, experimental DENV-1 challenge participants, and individuals with monotypic natural infection. Neutralization varied substantially among DENV-1 lineages and differed by exposure history. Several variants showed reduced neutralization following vaccination despite high overall antibody titers. Subsequent DENV-1 challenge broadened responses, which remained elevated through 180 days, whereas challenge of unvaccinated individuals produced lower potency and more lineage-specific decreases over time. Natural infection produced comparatively uniform neutralization across the panel. We used antigenic cartography to identify specific envelope amino acid positions associated with increased antigenic distance and reduced neutralization across vaccine and challenge sera. These findings demonstrate substantial within-serotype antigenic variation and support using diverse lineages to assess DENV vaccine-induced immunity.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to investigate how genetic variation within dengue virus-1 (DENV-1) lineages influences the breadth and durability of antibody responses elicited by infection and vaccination. The background highlights that DENV genetic diversity may impact vaccine-induced immunity.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated neutralization responses using sera from tetravalent vaccine recipients, experimental DENV-1 challenge participants, and individuals with monotypic natural infection. A panel of DENV-1 reporter virus particles was developed to encompass ~74% of known global envelope protein diversity.
analysis.methods: Antigenic cartography was employed to identify specific envelope amino acid positions linked to increased antigenic distance and reduced neutralization across vaccine and challenge sera. Neutralization was assessed by evaluating responses to the DENV-1 panel.
analysis.main_results: Several DENV-1 variants exhibited reduced neutralization following vaccination, despite high overall antibody titers. Subsequent DENV-1 challenge broadened responses, which remained elevated through 180 days, whereas challenge of unvaccinated individuals produced lower potency and more lineage-specific decreases over time.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate significant within-serotype antigenic variation and suggest that diverse DENV-1 lineages should be used to evaluate vaccine-induced immunity. This highlights the importance of lineage diversity in assessing immune responses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results have implications for improving the design of DENV vaccines and understanding the effectiveness of immune responses against different viral lineages. They also support the need for broader antigenic coverage in vaccine development.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on sera from specific populations and the use of reporter virus particles. The evidence is moderate, as the findings are based on observed neutralization patterns without direct causal evidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores how genetic variation within dengue virus-1 (DENV-1) lineages affects the breadth and durability of antibody responses elicited by infection and vaccination. papers.source_body_en: Abstract Dengue virus (DENV) genetic diversity within serotypes may influence the breadth and durability of vaccine-induced immunity. We developed a panel of DENV-1 reporter virus particles encompassing ~ 74% of known global envelope protein diversity and evaluated neutralization using sera from tetravalent vaccine recipients, experimental DENV-1 challenge participants, and individuals with monotypic natural infection. Neutralization varied substantially among DENV-1 lineages and differed by exposure history. Several variants showed reduced neutralization following vaccination despite high overall antibody titers. Subsequent DENV-1 challenge broadened responses, which remained elevated through 180 days, whereas challenge of unvaccinated individuals produced lower potency and more lineage-specific decreases over time. Natural infection produced comparatively uniform neutralization across the panel. We used antigenic cartography to identify specific envelope amino acid positions associated with increased antigenic distance and reduced neutralization across vaccine and challenge sera. These findings demonstrate substantial within-serotype antigenic variation and support using diverse lineages to assess DENV vaccine-induced immunity.

papers.title: Assessment of the knowledge, attitude, and practices of the people on dengue fever and malaria in the central Nepal
papers.abstract: Dengue and malaria remain critical, resurgent public health challenges in Nepal. This study assessed the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) regarding these mosquito-borne diseases among 130 households in Hetauda Sub-Metropolitan City, Makawanpur. Utilizing a questionnaire-based survey, the study found that 28% of respondents self-reported a household history of dengue within the past year often cluster-infecting multiple family members while only 1% self-reported history of malaria. Participants demonstrated high knowledge regarding dengue vectors (87%) and prevention (72%), alongside strong confidence (97%) in their chosen treatment strategies. Conversely, knowledge regarding malaria transmission was remarkably low (13%). While community attitudes and knowledge favor dengue prevention, critical gaps persist regarding malaria. These findings underscore the need for targeted, community-level educational interventions and intensified vector control programs to mitigate transmission risks and strengthen regional public health resilience.

papers.title: Serum ferritin kinetics and ferritin-derived ratios in hospitalised adults with dengue: A prospective serial biomarker study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue causes major morbidity and mortality across India, where early identification of patients progressing to dengue shock syndrome or severe hepatitis remains an unmet need. Serum ferritin reflects macrophage activation, but its serial kinetics and ferritin-derived composite indices have not been rigorously evaluated in adult Indian populations. We characterised serial ferritin kinetics and evaluated two ferritin-derived ratios: the Ferritin-to-Platelet Ratio (FPR) and the Ferritin/ALT Ratio (FLR). METHODOLOGY: This prospective observational study enrolled 100 adult WHO 2009-confirmed dengue patients at SMIMER, Surat (June 2020-November 2021). Serum ferritin was measured by sandwich ELISA on hospital Days 1, 3 and 5 and was also analysed by day of illness; platelet count and transaminases were the lowest and highest values recorded during the stay, and outcomes were recorded if present at any time between admission and discharge. Severity was classified as non-severe (n = 68) or severe (n = 32). Non-circular endpoints-shock/DSS (n = 22), severe thrombocytopenia <20,000/μL (n = 28), and severe hepatitis AST/ALT ≥ 1,000 IU/L (n = 18)-were the primary outcomes for diagnostic accuracy. FPR and FLR were pre-specified composite indices and were compared with their component tests by paired DeLong tests. PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: Ferritin showed a rise-peak-fall trajectory across hospital days, peaking on Day 3 (mean 955 ± 177 ng/ml; Friedman p < 10-16); by day of illness it rose from a median of 700 ng/ml (illness days ≤3) to 950 ng/ml (days 6-7) and then plateaued. FPR Day 1 separated the severity groups with AUC 0.704 (95% CI 0.579-0.830); severe patients showed five-fold higher median FPR than non-severe patients (39.0 vs 7.5; p = 0.001). Against shock/DSS, FPR Day 1 had AUC 0.801 (95% CI 0.688-0.898), no higher than platelet count alone (AUC 0.784; DeLong p = 0.41). FLR Day 1 discriminated severe hepatitis with AUC 0.995 (95% CI 0.988-1.000), no higher than ALT alone (AUC 1.000; DeLong p = 0.23), the variable that defines this outcome. Against non-circular outcomes, Ferritin Day 1 discriminated shock/DSS with AUC 0.789 and severe thrombocytopenia with AUC 0.727. The ferritin-platelet inverse correlation was demographic-independent (partial Spearman rho=-0.392; p < 0.001). Ferritin offered no incremental benefit over platelet count alone (NRI = 0.143; IDI = 0.000). CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: Serum ferritin rose from admission to hospital Day 3 and was higher in patients with shock and severe thrombocytopenia. The Ferritin-to-Platelet Ratio and the Ferritin/ALT Ratio are low-cost, but neither discriminated better than the routine test it contains (platelet count or ALT). Because platelet count and transaminases entered the ratios as the lowest and highest values of the admission, and outcomes were recorded over the whole stay, both ratios are markers of disease severity rather than predictors of later shock or severe hepatitis. Prospective multi-centre studies with laboratory values and outcomes timed from admission are needed to test any predictive role.

papers.title: Toward More Reliable Dengue Early Warning: Bridging the Gap Between Theory and Practice.
papers.abstract: Dengue continues to expand globally, increasing pressure on health systems across tropical and subtropical regions. Despite advances in surveillance, data availability, and predictive modeling, early warning often remains insufficiently linked to timely public health action. The challenge, therefore, is not prediction alone but translating heterogeneous surveillance information into actionable intelligence. Key determinants, including climate, human mobility, adult female mosquito abundance, vector infection, asymptomatic infection, and population immunity, vary in feasibility, spatial and temporal resolution, and early-warning value. Climate indicators provide important context but may lack local specificity, and symptomatic case surveillance is constrained by underascertainment and reporting delays. Human mobility can improve spatial risk assessment and, in selected settings, forecasting, whereas adult mosquito surveillance provides complementary information on local vector abundance. The authors of the present study propose an Operationally Prioritized Early Warning (OPEW) framework that integrates sentinel surveillance, scale-aware interpretation of complementary signals, feasibility-based prioritization, event-triggered intensification, and explicit links between surveillance thresholds and predefined actions. The OPEW framework is not a validated prediction model but a testable operational framework that prioritizes information according to epidemiological relevance, timeliness, feasibility, and decision value. Prospective evaluation should assess predictive performance, actionable lead time, resource requirements, and public health outcomes against existing approaches.

papers.title_zh: 实现更可靠的登革热早期预警:弥合理论与实践之间的差距。
papers.source_body_en: Dengue continues to expand globally, increasing pressure on health systems across tropical and subtropical regions. Despite advances in surveillance, data availability, and predictive modeling, early warning often remains insufficiently linked to timely public health action. The challenge, therefore, is not prediction alone but translating heterogeneous surveillance information into actionable intelligence. Key determinants, including climate, human mobility, adult female mosquito abundance, vector infection, asymptomatic infection, and population immunity, vary in feasibility, spatial and temporal resolution, and early-warning value. Climate indicators provide important context but may lack local specificity, and symptomatic case surveillance is constrained by underascertainment and reporting delays. Human mobility can improve spatial risk assessment and, in selected settings, forecasting, whereas adult mosquito surveillance provides complementary information on local vector abundance. The authors of the present study propose an Operationally Prioritized Early Warning (OPEW) framework that integrates sentinel surveillance, scale-aware interpretation of complementary signals, feasibility-based prioritization, event-triggered intensification, and explicit links between surveillance thresholds and predefined actions. The OPEW framework is not a validated prediction model but a testable operational framework that prioritizes information according to epidemiological relevance, timeliness, feasibility, and decision value. Prospective evaluation should assess predictive performance, actionable lead time, resource requirements, and public health outcomes against existing approaches.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革热继续在全球蔓延,给热带和亚热带地区的卫生系统带来越来越大的压力。尽管在 监测、数据可用性和预测模型方面取得了进步,但早期预警往往与及时的公共卫生行动联系不够。因此,挑战不仅仅是预测,而是将异构的 监测 信息转化为可操作的情报。关键决定因素,包括气候、人口流动性、成年雌性蚊子丰度、媒介 感染、无症状感染和群体免疫力,在可行性、时空分辨率和预警价值方面各不相同。气候指标提供了重要的背景信息,但可能缺乏当地的特异性,并且有症状的病例 监测 受到确定不足和报告延迟的限制。人类流动性可以改善空间风险评估,并在选定的环境中进行预测,而成年蚊子 监测 则提供有关当地 媒介 丰度的补充信息。本研究的作者提出了一种操作优先级预警(OPEW)框架,该框架集成了哨兵 监测、互补信号的尺度感知解释、基于可行性的优先级、事件触发的强化以及 监测 阈值和预定义操作之间的显式链接。OPEW 框架不是一个经过验证的预测模型,而是一个可测试的操作框架,它根据流行病学相关性、及时性、可行性和决策价值对信息进行优先级排序。前瞻性评估应根据现有方法评估预测性能、可操作的交付时间、资源需求和公共卫生结果。

papers.title: Spatio-temporal clustering of dengue in Valle del Cauca, Colombia.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue is endemic in Colombia's Valle del Cauca region. The precise timing and spatial scale of seasonal dengue transmission necessary for effective reactive interventions at the sub-municipal level across the 42 municipalities of Valle del Cauca remain unclear. This study aimed to identify spatio-temporal dengue clusters in Valle del Cauca. METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: A retrospective observational study was conducted using individual laboratory-confirmed dengue cases, including residential geolocation and consultation dates, reported by healthcare providers to the Sistema Nacional de Vigilancia en Salud Pública (SIVIGILA) in 2022. Residence was utilized as the probable site of infection. Spatio-temporal clustering was analyzed using Kulldorff's space-time scan statistic to identify statistically significant dengue clusters. Results were mapped using R. As a second aim, the association between clinical and demographic characteristics and dengue hospitalization was evaluated. Of 3,964 dengue cases reported in Valle del Cauca in 2022, 2,232 (56%) were laboratory-confirmed. Of these, 1,973 occurred in the defined areas of the nine municipalities included in the spatio-temporal analysis of this study. We identified 28 clusters at the sub-municipal level, with radii of 0-0.98 km, lasting 1-6 months and containing 10-114 cases. Twenty-six clusters (92.9%) spanned both warm-dry and cool-wet seasons, and clusters accounted for 32.0% of spatially analyzed cases. 960 patients were hospitalized. Lower socioeconomic status (OR 1.30, 95% CI 1.07-1.57), enrollment in the state-subsidized insurance scheme (OR 1.74, 95% CI 1.41-2.15) compared with the contributory scheme, and age ≥ 70 years compared to ages 20-29 years (OR 2.47, 95% CI 1.51-4.04) were associated with higher odds of hospitalization. CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: This study identified dengue clusters at the sub-municipal level with the potential to inform reactive dengue control interventions and demonstrated a disproportionate impact on socioeconomically disadvantaged populations and the elderly in Valle del Cauca, Colombia.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热在哥伦比亚考卡山谷地区流行。在考卡山谷 42 个城市的市以下一级采取有效反应干预措施所需的季节性登革热 传播 的精确时间和空间规模仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用医疗保健提供者于 2022 年向国家卫生健康系统 (SIVIGILA) 报告的个别实验室确诊的登革热病例(包括居住地理位置和就诊日期)进行了一项回顾性观察研究。其中,1,973 例发生在本研究时空分析所包含的 9 个城市的指定区域。
elements_zh.methods: 使用库尔多夫的时空扫描统计分析时空聚类,以识别统计上显着的登革热聚类。使用 R 绘制结果。
elements_zh.main_results: 2022 年,考卡山谷报告了 3,964 例登革热病例,其中 2,232 例(56%)经过实验室确诊。我们在市以下级别确定了28个聚集性病例,半径为0-0.98公里,持续1-6个月,包含10-114例病例。26 个集群 (92.9%) 跨越暖干季和冷湿季,集群占空间分析病例的 32.0%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这项研究确定了市以下级别的登革热集群,有可能为反应性登革热控制干预措施提供信息。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为反应性登革热控制干预措施提供信息,并强调登革热对哥伦比亚考卡山谷社会经济弱势群体和老年人的不成比例的影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和对报告数据的依赖而受到限制,但由于它基于实验室确诊病例和统计分析,因此证据有力。

papers.title: The impact of climate variability on dengue virus case incidence in Sindh, Pakistan: Post-2022 flooding.
papers.abstract: Dengue virus is spread primarily by the Aedes aegypti and Ae. albopictus mosquitoes is a self-limiting viral disease primarily present in the tropical and subtropical regions of the world. Temperature and rainfall impact vector development, virus replication, and habitat suitability for Ae. albopictus larvae and pupae. Pakistan, located in Southeast Asia, is one country where DENV is endemic and impacts thousands of lives each year. In recent years, Pakistan has been hardly hit by climate change, with heavy rainfalls and flooding recurring each year, with simultaneous surges of dengue virus across the country. In this paper, we analyze the monthly dengue virus disease data from Sindh Pakistan, from 2020-2025 to understand the impacts of flooding, rainfall, and temperature fluctuations on dengue case incidence in the region. We use parametric generalized linear models and the generalized additive model. Our results indicate that monthly confirmed dengue cases exhibit a strong seasonality, with the great majority of cases concentrated in the post-monsoon months (September-November). A 1-month lag in rainfall was associated with a statistically significant increase in dengue incidence (IRR = 1.008, 95% CI: 1.003-1.012, p = 0.002), corresponding to a 0.8% increase in expected case counts per unit (mm) increase in rainfall one month prior. In contrast, neither lagged temperature term reached statistical significance.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to understand how climate variability, specifically flooding, rainfall and temperature fluctuations, affects dengue virus case incidence in Sindh, Pakistan. Dengue virus is a self-limiting viral disease primarily present in tropical and subtropical regions, with significant public health impacts.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed monthly dengue virus disease data from Sindh, Pakistan, between 2020 and 2025. It focused on the impacts of climate factors on dengue case incidence in the region, with a particular emphasis on post-monsoon months.
analysis.methods: The researchers employed parametric generalized linear models and generalized additive models to assess the relationship between climate variables and dengue incidence. They examined the effects of rainfall and temperature on case counts, incorporating a 1-month lag for rainfall.
analysis.main_results: Monthly confirmed dengue cases showed strong seasonality, with the majority occurring in post-monsoon months (September-November). A 1-month lag in rainfall was associated with a statistically significant increase in dengue incidence (IRR = 1.008, 95% CI: 1.003-1.012, p = 0.002), corresponding to a 0.8% increase in expected case counts per unit (mm) increase in rainfall one month prior.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that rainfall, particularly with a 1-month lag, has a significant impact on dengue incidence, highlighting the importance of climate factors in disease dynamics. This study provides novel insights into the relationship between climate variability and dengue outbreaks in Sindh.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results can inform public health strategies for dengue surveillance and prevention in regions experiencing climate variability, particularly in Sindh, Pakistan. Understanding these relationships may help in predicting and mitigating future outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on monthly case data and does not account for other potential factors influencing dengue incidence. The evidence is moderate, as it relies on observational data and statistical modeling without experimental validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the impact of climate variability, specifically flooding, rainfall, and temperature fluctuations, on dengue virus case incidence in Sindh, Pakistan, from 2020 to 2025. The research highlights the strong seasonality of dengue cases, with the majority occurring in post-monsoon months. A 1-month lag in rainfall was found to be statistically significantly associated with increased dengue incidence, with an estimated 0.8% rise in case counts per unit increase in rainfall. The study employs generalized linear and additive models to analyze these relationships, offering novel insights into the role of climate factors in dengue outbreaks. papers.title_zh: 气候变化对巴基斯坦信德省 登革病毒 案例 发病率 的影响:2022 年后洪水。
papers.source_body_en: Dengue virus is spread primarily by the Aedes aegypti and Ae. albopictus mosquitoes is a self-limiting viral disease primarily present in the tropical and subtropical regions of the world. Temperature and rainfall impact vector development, virus replication, and habitat suitability for Ae. albopictus larvae and pupae. Pakistan, located in Southeast Asia, is one country where DENV is endemic and impacts thousands of lives each year. In recent years, Pakistan has been hardly hit by climate change, with heavy rainfalls and flooding recurring each year, with simultaneous surges of dengue virus across the country. In this paper, we analyze the monthly dengue virus disease data from Sindh Pakistan, from 2020-2025 to understand the impacts of flooding, rainfall, and temperature fluctuations on dengue case incidence in the region. We use parametric generalized linear models and the generalized additive model. Our results indicate that monthly confirmed dengue cases exhibit a strong seasonality, with the great majority of cases concentrated in the post-monsoon months (September-November). A 1-month lag in rainfall was associated with a statistically significant increase in dengue incidence (IRR = 1.008, 95% CI: 1.003-1.012, p = 0.002), corresponding to a 0.8% increase in expected case counts per unit (mm) increase in rainfall one month prior. In contrast, neither lagged temperature term reached statistical significance.

papers.title: An early activated CD38highCD209highCD36low monocyte phenotype is associated with progression to severe dengue
papers.abstract: Background: Although monocytes are among the principal target cells of dengue virus (DENV) infection we sought to investigate monocyte phenotypic markers associated with disease severity and evaluate their potential as prognostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets. Methods: Differences in monocyte subpopulations and phenotypic markers were assessed by flow cytometry in patients with dengue fever (DF=33) and dengue haemorrhagic fever (DHF=21) and compared to health controls (HCs=20). Further in vitro experiments were done by co-culturing peripheral blood mononucleocytes (PBMCs) of healthy individuals (n=8) with DENV2, DENV3, NS1 antigen of both serotypes and LPS. The changes in expression of CD36 and CD38 in vitro in monocytes were assessed. Results: A significant expansion of intermediate monocytes and a contraction of the classical monocytes was seen in patients with DHF compared to DF and HCs, with no significant differences within the non-classical monocytes. Patients who progressed to develop DHF, exhibited an activated monocyte phenotype characterized by, expansion of CD38high, CD209high, CD86high, HLA-DRhigh, CD36low, intermediate monocyte subset. The highest expression of CD38 and CD86 was seen in non-classical monocytes, and CD209 and HLA-DR in intermediate monocytes. Most significant downregulation of CD36 was observed in non-classical monocytes. CD38 expression on monocytes (especially classical monocytes) positively and significantly correlated with liver transaminases and serum ferritin levels. Co-culture of PBMCs with DENV3 led to significant downregulation of CD36 (p=0.023). Conclusions: These results suggest that early alterations in monocyte activation, antigen presentation, viral entry, and lipid sensing pathways contribute to dengue immunopathogenesis.
authors: M H M Thisara S HETTI MUDALIGE THIS Perera

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates monocyte phenotypic markers associated with disease severity in dengue infection, focusing on their potential as prognostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets. Using flow cytometry, monocyte subpopulations were compared in patients with dengue fever and dengue haemorrhagic fever against health controls. The results showed significant expansion of intermediate monocytes and contraction of classical monocytes in DHF patients, with notable changes in CD38, CD86, CD209, and CD36 expression. These findings suggest that early monocyte activation and functional changes may contribute to dengue immunopathogenesis. The study's implications could guide future research on biomarkers and targeted therapies for severe dengue. However, the evidence is based on abstract-only data and a limited sample size, which may affect the strength and generalisability of the conclusions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在研究与登革热感染疾病严重程度相关的单核细胞表型标记物,并评估它们作为预后生物标记物和治疗靶点的潜力。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究将 登革热 (DF=33) 和登革出血热 (DHF=21) 患者与健康对照 (HCs=20) 患者的单核细胞亚群和表型标记物进行了比较。
elements_zh.methods: 使用流式细胞术评估 登革热 和登革出血热患者以及健康对照的单核细胞亚群和表型标记物。
elements_zh.main_results: 与 DF 和 HC 相比,在 DHF 患者中观察到中间单核细胞的显着扩张和经典单核细胞的收缩,而非经典单核细胞内没有显着差异。CD38 和 CD86 在非经典单核细胞中表达最高,CD209 和 HLA-DR 在中间单核细胞中表达最高。在非经典单核细胞中观察到最显着的 CD36 下调。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结果表明,单核细胞激活、抗原呈递、病毒进入和脂质传感途径的早期改变有助于登革热免疫发病机制。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为预测疾病严重程度的生物标志物的开发提供信息,并指导登革热感染的针对性治疗策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于抽象证据,并且结果基于相对较小的样本量,这可能会影响研究结果的普遍性。证据的强度中等。

papers.title: An Integrated Review of Dengue Fever!
papers.abstract: Dengue is the most widespread human arboviral infection, transmitted primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, with a global incidence that has risen sharply due to climate change, rapid urbanization, and the expanding distribution of mosquito vectors. This review synthesizes current knowledge on three interconnected dimensions of dengue epidemiology, pathophysiology, and molecular diagnostics to provide an integrated understanding of its evolving burden and clinical challenges. Dengue virus (DENV), comprising four distinct serotypes, causes a wide clinical spectrum from asymptomatic infection to severe disease, with antibody-dependent enhancement during secondary infections playing a key role in progression to plasma leakage, shock, and organ impairment. Globally, dengue continues to expand, with Asia carrying the highest burden; in Bangladesh, the shifting dominance of circulating serotypes and changing geographic patterns highlight the need for robust surveillance. Advances in early diagnostic tools such as NS1 antigen detection and RT-PCR have significantly improved timely case identification, while serological assays aid differentiation between primary and secondary infections, crucial for risk assessment. Despite these improvements, diagnostic accessibility remains limited in many resource-constrained settings, and disease management continues to rely on supportive care due to the absence of specific antiviral therapy. Effective control, therefore, depends on integrated vector management, improved diagnostic capacity, and the cautious use of vaccines such as Dengvaxia, alongside ongoing efforts to develop safer and broader vaccine options. Continued research and adaptive public health strategies remain essential to reducing morbidity and mortality from this increasingly important global health threat. J Enam Med Col 2023; 13(3): 110-115

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 登革热是最广泛的人类虫媒病毒感染,主要由埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊传播,由于气候变化、快速城市化和蚊子 媒介 分布范围的扩大,全球 发病率 急剧上升。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述综合了登革热 流行病学、病理生理学和分子诊断三个相互关联的维度的当前知识,以提供对其不断变化的负担和临床挑战的综合理解。NS1 抗原检测和 RT-PCR 等早期诊断工具的进步显着提高了病例识别的及时性,而血清学检测有助于区分原发性感染和继发性感染,这对于风险评估至关重要。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 抗体依赖性增强 (DENV) 包含四种不同的血清型,可引起从无症状感染到严重疾病的广泛临床谱,其中继发感染期间的 抗体依赖性增强 在血浆渗漏、休克和器官损伤的进展中发挥着关键作用。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 尽管有这些改进,但在许多资源有限的环境中,诊断的可及性仍然有限,并且由于缺乏特定的 抗病毒药物 疗法,疾病管理仍然依赖于支持性护理。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 在全球范围内,登革热继续蔓延,其中亚洲负担最重;在孟加拉国,流行血清型的主导地位的变化和地理格局的变化凸显了对强大的 监测 的需求。持续的研究和适应性公共卫生战略对于降低这一日益重要的全球健康威胁的发病率和 死亡率 仍然至关重要。

Despite these improvements, diagnostic accessibility remains limited in many resource-constrained settings, and disease management continues to rely on supportive care due to the absence of specific antiviral therapy. Effective control, therefore, depends on integrated vector management, improved diagnostic capacity, and the cautious use of vaccines such as Dengvaxia, alongside ongoing efforts to develop safer and broader vaccine options. Continued research and adaptive public health strategies remain essential to reducing morbidity and mortality from this increasingly important global health threat. papers.title: From Pilot Plan to Public Trust: Community Perceptions of a Dengue Vaccine Campaign in Iquitos, Peru
papers.abstract: Abstract Background A dengue vaccine has the potential to significantly reduce dengue transmission, severe disease, and mortality. In November 2024, Peru started to roll out the Qdenga (TAK-003) dengue vaccine for children ages 10–16 in four priority regions with historically high levels of dengue transmission. This qualitative study examines facilitators and barriers to the roll out of the Qdenga vaccine from parent and health provider and authority perspectives in Iquitos, Peru. Methods Six focus group discussions (FGDs) (n = 55) with parents of eligible children and four key informant interviews (KIIs) with Loreto Regional Health Department (GERESA) nursing coordinators were conducted in Iquitos. Recorded sessions were transcribed and analyzed using thematic analysis and organized using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR). A complementary dataset from Piura was used to further contextualize the findings. Results Policy word choice created unintended implementation barriers, specifically the use of the term “pilot plan” in the technical guidance created distrust among many community members, who felt that their children were “guinea pigs” in a plan to test the safety and efficacy of a new vaccine. The centralized plan of a clinic-based strategy resulted in low uptake, so local health districts adapted their strategies to involve schools and door-to-door vaccination outreach, which ultimately led to the achievement of the first dose vaccination goal. Trust and convenience complemented each other, as participants reported high levels of trust in public health officials and appreciated the school and door-to-door based strategies. Conclusions In settings where transportation to health facilities is challenging and the community expresses hesitancy regarding vaccination programs, this study suggests that a robust, on-the-ground public health campaign that meets participants and their children where they are is an effective strategy for ensuring vaccine uptake. It also suggests the importance of local health facilities effectively adapting national vaccination campaign strategies to local settings.

analysis.scope_and_question: This study focuses on the implementation of the Qdenga (TAK-003) dengue vaccine in Iquitos, Peru, specifically examining community perceptions and the factors influencing vaccine uptake among parents and health providers. The central question is how community trust and convenience affect the success of dengue vaccination campaigns in areas with high dengue transmission and limited access to health facilities.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The study employed qualitative methods, including six focus group discussions (FGDs) with 55 parents and four key informant interviews with health department nursing coordinators. Data were collected through thematic analysis and organized using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR). A complementary dataset from Piura was also used to contextualize the findings.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The study concludes that a centralized clinic-based strategy for dengue vaccination led to low uptake, but local health districts adapted by incorporating school-based and door-to-door outreach, which improved vaccine coverage. Trust in public health officials and convenience of these adapted strategies were identified as key facilitators of vaccine acceptance.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The use of the term 'pilot plan' in technical guidance created unintended distrust among community members, who perceived the vaccine as an experiment on children. There is a gap in understanding how different communication strategies impact vaccine acceptance in diverse settings, particularly in areas with high dengue transmission.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The study highlights the need for local health facilities to adapt national vaccination strategies to community-specific contexts. It also suggests that clear and transparent communication about vaccine implementation is crucial to building trust and ensuring high uptake in dengue-prone areas.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores community perceptions of the Qdenga dengue vaccine rollout in Iquitos, Peru, focusing on the factors influencing vaccine acceptance. The research identifies that the term 'pilot plan' in technical guidance generated distrust, with community members viewing the vaccine as an experiment. A centralized clinic-based strategy led to low uptake, but local adaptations such as school-based and door-to-door vaccination improved coverage. Trust in public health officials and convenience were key facilitators of vaccine acceptance. The findings emphasize the importance of tailoring national vaccination strategies to local contexts and improving communication to build community confidence in dengue prevention efforts.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本研究重点关注秘鲁伊基托斯 Qdenga (TAK-003) 登革热 疫苗 的实施情况,特别研究了社区认知以及影响家长和医疗服务提供者采用 疫苗 的因素。核心问题是,社区信任和便利性如何影响登革热 疫苗接种 活动在登革热高发地区和卫生设施有限的地区取得成功。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该研究采用定性方法,包括与 55 名家长进行的 6 次焦点小组讨论 (FGD) 以及与卫生部门护理协调员的 4 次关键知情人访谈。通过主题分析收集数据,并使用实施研究综合框架(CFIR)进行组织。还使用了 Piura 的补充数据集来说明研究结果。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该研究的结论是,基于集中诊所的登革热 疫苗接种 策略导致采用率较低,但当地卫生区通过纳入基于学校和挨家挨户的宣传进行了调整,从而提高了 疫苗 的覆盖率。对公共卫生官员的信任和这些调整策略的便利性被认为是 疫苗 接受的关键促进因素。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 在技​​术指南中使用“试点计划”一词无意中引起了社区成员的不信任,他们认为 疫苗 是一项针对儿童的实验。在理解不同的沟通策略如何影响不同环境中的 疫苗 接受度方面存在差距,特别是在登革热 疫苗 高发地区。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该研究强调地方卫生机构需要根据社区特定情况调整国家 疫苗接种 战略。它还表明,有关 疫苗 实施的清晰、透明的沟通对于在登革热多发地区建立信任和确保高采用率至关重要。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: This study focuses on the implementation of the Qdenga (TAK-003) dengue vaccine in Iquitos, Peru, specifically examining community perceptions and the factors influencing vaccine uptake among parents and health providers. The central question is how community trust and convenience affect the success of dengue vaccination campaigns in areas with high dengue transmission and limited access to health facilities.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The study employed qualitative methods, including six focus group discussions (FGDs) with 55 parents and four key informant interviews with health department nursing coordinators. Data were collected through thematic analysis and organized using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR). A complementary dataset from Piura was also used to contextualize the findings.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The study concludes that a centralized clinic-based strategy for dengue vaccination led to low uptake, but local health districts adapted by incorporating school-based and door-to-door outreach, which improved vaccine coverage. Trust in public health officials and convenience of these adapted strategies were identified as key facilitators of vaccine acceptance.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The use of the term 'pilot plan' in technical guidance created unintended distrust among community members, who perceived the vaccine as an experiment on children. There is a gap in understanding how different communication strategies impact vaccine acceptance in diverse settings, particularly in areas with high dengue transmission.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: The study highlights the need for local health facilities to adapt national vaccination strategies to community-specific contexts. papers.title_zh: 从试点计划到公众信任:社区对秘鲁伊基托斯登革热 疫苗 运动的看法
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background A dengue vaccine has the potential to significantly reduce dengue transmission, severe disease, and mortality. In November 2024, Peru started to roll out the Qdenga (TAK-003) dengue vaccine for children ages 10–16 in four priority regions with historically high levels of dengue transmission. This qualitative study examines facilitators and barriers to the roll out of the Qdenga vaccine from parent and health provider and authority perspectives in Iquitos, Peru. Methods Six focus group discussions (FGDs) (n = 55) with parents of eligible children and four key informant interviews (KIIs) with Loreto Regional Health Department (GERESA) nursing coordinators were conducted in Iquitos. Recorded sessions were transcribed and analyzed using thematic analysis and organized using the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research (CFIR). A complementary dataset from Piura was used to further contextualize the findings. Results Policy word choice created unintended implementation barriers, specifically the use of the term “pilot plan” in the technical guidance created distrust among many community members, who felt that their children were “guinea pigs” in a plan to test the safety and efficacy of a new vaccine. The centralized plan of a clinic-based strategy resulted in low uptake, so local health districts adapted their strategies to involve schools and door-to-door vaccination outreach, which ultimately led to the achievement of the first dose vaccination goal. Trust and convenience complemented each other, as participants reported high levels of trust in public health officials and appreciated the school and door-to-door based strategies. Conclusions In settings where transportation to health facilities is challenging and the community expresses hesitancy regarding vaccination programs, this study suggests that a robust, on-the-ground public health campaign that meets participants and their children where they are is an effective strategy for ensuring vaccine uptake. It also suggests the importance of local health facilities effectively adapting national vaccination campaign strategies to local settings.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 登革热 疫苗 有可能显着减少登革热 传播、严重疾病和 死亡率。2024 年 11 月,秘鲁开始在登革热 传播 发病率历史最高的四个重点地区针对 10 至 16 岁儿童推出 Qdenga (TAK-003) 登革热 疫苗。这项定性研究从秘鲁伊基托斯的家长和医疗服务提供者以及权威人士的角度审视了 Qdenga 疫苗 推出的促进因素和障碍。方法 在伊基托斯与符合条件的儿童家长进行了 6 次焦点小组讨论 (FGD) (n = 55),并与洛雷托地区卫生局 (GERESA) 护理协调员进行了 4 次关键知情者访谈 (KII)。使用主题分析对录制的会议进行转录和分析,并使用实施研究综合框架 (CFIR) 进行组织。来自 Piura 的补充数据集被用来进一步将研究结果结合起来。结果 政策措辞的选择造成了意想不到的实施障碍,特别是在技术指南中使用“试点计划”一词引起了许多社区成员的不信任,他们认为自己的孩子是测试新 疫苗 安全性和有效性的计划中的“小白鼠”。基于诊所的策略的集中计划导致采用率较低,因此当地卫生区调整了策略,让学校参与并进行挨家挨户的 疫苗接种 外展,最终实现了第一剂 疫苗接种 目标。信任和便利是相辅相成的,因为参与者报告了对公共卫生官员的高度信任,并对学校和挨家挨户的策略表示赞赏。结论 在前往医疗机构的交通存在困难且社区对 疫苗接种 计划表示犹豫的情况下,本研究表明,在参与者及其子女所在地开展强有力的实地公共卫生活动是确保 疫苗 吸收的有效策略。它还表明当地卫生机构有效地将国家 疫苗接种 运动战略适应当地环境的重要性。

papers.title: A CBC-derived score associated with dengue NS1 antigen positivity among suspected dengue patients in Dhaka: a retrospective model-development study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Early diagnostic triage for suspected dengue is important in high-volume settings, yet confirmatory testing may be delayed or intermittently available. This study aimed to develop and internally validate a simple complete blood count (CBC)-derived score to estimate the likelihood of same-day dengue non-structural protein 1 (NS1) antigen positivity among suspected dengue patients in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Methods We conducted a retrospective model-development study at Uttara Adhunik Medical College Hospital using data from patients with clinical suspicion of dengue between 19 August and 12 October 2023. The final analysis included 596 unique patients who underwent CBC and NS1 testing on the same day. Least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) penalized logistic regression was used for variable selection among routinely available demographic and hematological predictors. Selected predictors were refit using unpenalized logistic regression to derive a CBC score. Internal validation and calibration were assessed using bootstrap optimism correction with 400 resamples. Results Among 596 patients, 306 (51.3%) were NS1 positive. The final parsimonious model retained platelet count rescaled per 10 x 10 9 /L, white blood cell count, and monocyte count. The optimism-corrected AUC was 0.9429. At the Youden-derived cutoff of 11.825, the final integer score had sensitivity 0.833 (95% CI, 0.787-0.873), specificity 0.966 (95% CI, 0.938-0.983), PPV 0.962 (95% CI, 0.932-0.982), NPV 0.846 (95% CI, 0.802-0.883), and accuracy 0.898 (95% CI, 0.870-0.921). A rounded cutoff of 12 produced similar performance. In benchmark analysis, the final model showed a modest improvement over platelet count alone (AUC 0.944 vs 0.931; Delta AUC 0.012; DeLong p=0.00364). Conclusion A three-parameter CBC score can estimate the likelihood of NS1 antigen positivity among suspected dengue patients in this single-center dataset. The score should be interpreted as a CBC-only triage adjunct, not as a replacement for confirmatory dengue testing. External validation in independent cohorts is needed before routine clinical use.

papers.title: Using Real-Time Health Care Provider Feedback to Guide Response Efforts During a Dengue Outbreak, US Virgin Islands, 2024-2025.
papers.abstract: During 2024, a dengue outbreak occurred in the US Virgin Islands (USVI). To guide response efforts, we assessed health care providers' practices, experiences, and needs related to dengue diagnostics, clinical management, and reporting during the ongoing outbreak. A rapid needs assessment was conducted using semi-structured interviews with 9 clinicians across the USVI. Interview data were coded into predefined topic areas and analyzed to identify key gaps and actionable opportunities for support. Outcomes revealed gaps in clinical training, diagnostic support, and clinician-community engagement. Providers reported limited confidence in recognizing warning signs and expressed a need for additional training and decision-making tools. Findings indicated that clinicians often relied on clinical judgment for diagnosis but faced challenges related to diagnostic testing, including cost, long turnaround times, and uncertainty about test selection. Gaps in community awareness and misconceptions about dengue transmission were also identified. The rapid needs assessment was led by the Virgin Islands Department of Health and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, and results informed rapid implementation of targeted interventions, including clinician training resources, expanded diagnostic testing pathways, and enhanced community outreach efforts, such as streamlined diagnostic testing processes and community outreach. This case study highlights the value of rapid assessments in guiding timely public health responses during outbreaks through provider-centered feedback.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在登革热 暴发 期间,我们对美属维尔京群岛的 9 名临床医生进行了半结构化访谈,进行了快速需求评估。
elements_zh.methods: 访谈数据被编码到预定义的主题领域并进行分析,以确定关键差距和可行的支持机会。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了快速评估在通过以提供者为中心的反馈指导 暴发 期间及时公共卫生应对方面的价值。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为有针对性的干预措施提供信息,包括临床医生培训资源、扩大诊断测试途径以及加强社区外展工作,例如简化诊断测试流程和社区宣传活动。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量小和依赖临床医生自我报告数据的限制,这可能会引入偏差。由于评估的定性性质,证据的强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 2024 年,美属维尔京群岛 (USVI) 发生了登革热 暴发。为了指导应对工作,我们在正在进行的 暴发 期间评估了医疗保健提供者与登革热诊断、临床管理和报告相关的做法、经验和需求。通过半结构化访谈,对美属维尔京群岛的 9 名临床医生进行了快速需求评估。访谈数据被编码到预定义的主题领域并进行分析,以确定关键差距和可行的支持机会。结果揭示了临床培训、诊断支持和临床医生社区参与方面的差距。提供商表示,他们对识别警告信号的信心有限,并表示需要额外的培训和决策工具。研究结果表明,临床医生经常依赖对 诊断 的临床判断,但面临与诊断测试相关的挑战,包括成本、周转时间长和测试选择的不确定性。还发现了社区对登革热 传播 的认识差距和误解。快速需求评估由维尔京群岛卫生部和疾病控制与预防中心牵头,结果为快速实施有针对性的干预措施提供了依据,包括临床医生培训资源、扩大诊断测试途径以及加强社区外展工作,例如简化诊断测试流程和社区外展。本案例研究强调了快速评估在通过以提供者为中心的反馈指导 暴发 期间及时公共卫生应对方面的价值。

papers.title: Adult Immunogenicity and Descriptive Safety of TAK-003 Dengue Vaccination: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Background: Adult TAK-003 data differ by formulation, baseline dengue status, coadministration, and outcome definition. Objective: To synthesize adult immunogenicity and safety of the licensed two-dose final formulation of TAK-003. Methods: We searched PubMed, Scopus, CENTRAL-derived records, registries, regulatory sources, and citations to the final search update. Screening, extraction, appraisal, and analysis used a reproducible computational workflow without independent duplicate verification. Seropositivity and 270-day serious adverse event (SAE) risk were modeled with binomial-normal logit models; comparative reactogenicity used random-effects risk ratios with modified Hartung-Knapp intervals. Certainty was graded by outcome, and a sensitivity analysis added the single-arm DEN307 cohort. Results: Of 1,090 records, 606 unique records (553 publications and 53 registry records) were screened; 473 publications were excluded and 80 were retrieved. Five trials supplied quantitative outcomes. Among 620 baseline-seronegative adults, pooled seropositivity about 30 days after dose 2 was 98.7% for DENV-1 (95% CI 95.8–99.6), 99.0% for DENV-2 (97.9–99.6), 96.9% for DENV-3 (95.2–98.0), and 98.4% for DENV-4 (97.0–99.1). With DEN307 added, estimates were 98.8%, 99.2%, 97.1%, and 98.5% (752 participants per serotype). Across four cohorts, 29/1,468 participants had an SAE through day 270 (pooled risk 2.0%, 95% CI 1.4–2.8). Pain and headache estimates, each from two studies, were highly imprecise. Conclusion: Final-formulation TAK-003 gave high short-term seropositivity in selected adult trial populations. The SAE risk was uncontrolled and does not establish comparative safety. Certainty was low or very low, and inference is limited by study size, surrogate outcomes, and uncontrolled safety data.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the immunogenicity and safety of the final two-dose formulation of TAK-003 in adults. Dengue viruses 1–4 and dengue disease are the target entities, with other flaviviruses considered near-neighbour exclusions. The central question is to synthesize adult immunogenicity and safety data for the licensed TAK-003 vaccine.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The evidence base includes records from PubMed, Scopus, CENTRAL-derived records, registries, regulatory sources, and citations. The review used a reproducible computational workflow for screening, extraction, appraisal, and analysis without independent duplicate verification. Seropositivity and 270-day serious adverse event (SAE) risk were modeled using binomial-normal logit models, while comparative reactogenicity was analyzed using random-effects risk ratios with modified Hartung-Knapp intervals.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The pooled seropositivity estimates for DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, and DENV-4 were 98.7%, 99.0%, 96.9%, and 98.4%, respectively, 30 days after dose 2. The SAE risk was 2.0% (95% CI 1.4–2.8) across four cohorts. The final-formulation TAK-003 demonstrated high short-term seropositivity in selected adult trial populations.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: Certainty was graded as low or very low due to study size, surrogate outcomes, and uncontrolled safety data. The SAE risk was uncontrolled and does not establish comparative safety. Pain and headache estimates were highly imprecise, with each derived from only two studies.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to improve certainty in safety assessments and to address the imprecision in reactogenicity estimates. Surveillance and risk assessment should focus on long-term safety and efficacy, particularly in diverse populations and regions. Additional studies are required to evaluate the vaccine's performance in different serostatus groups and to refine outcome definitions.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluate the immunogenicity and safety of the final two-dose formulation of TAK-003 in adults. The review synthesized data from five trials, reporting high seropositivity rates (98.7–99.0%) for DENV-1, DENV-2, DENV-3, and DENV-4 30 days post-vaccination. The pooled risk of serious adverse events (SAE) was 2.0% (95% CI 1.4–2.8) through day 270. However, certainty was low or very low due to study size, surrogate outcomes, and uncontrolled safety data. Pain and headache estimates were imprecise, with each derived from only two studies. The review highlights the need for further research to improve safety assessments and address reactogenicity imprecision, as well as to refine outcome definitions and evaluate vaccine performance in diverse populations.
