papers.abstract_zh: 背景:成人 TAK-003 数据因配方、基线登革热状态、共同给药和结果定义而异。目的:合成获得许可的 TAK-003 两剂量最终制剂的成人免疫原性和安全性。方法:我们检索了 PubMed、Scopus、CENTRAL 衍生记录、注册、监管来源和最终检索更新的引用。筛选、提取、评估和分析使用可重复的计算工作流程,无需独立的重复验证。使用二项正态 Logit 模型对血清阳性率和 270 天严重不良事件 (SAE) 风险进行建模;比较反应原性使用随机效应风险比和修正的 Hartung-Knapp 区间。确定性按结果分级,敏感性分析添加了单臂 DEN307 队列研究。结果:在 1,090 条记录中,筛选了 606 条独特记录(553 条出版物和 53 条登记记录);排除 473 篇出版物,检索 80 篇。五项试验提供了定量结果。在 620 名基线血清阴性成人中,第 2 剂给药后约 30 天,DENV-1 的汇总血清阳性率为 98.7%(95% CI 95.8-99.6),DENV-2 为 99.0%(97.9-99.6),DENV-3 为 96.9%(95.2-98.0),DENV-4 为 98.4% (97.0–99.1)。添加 DEN307 后,估计值为 98.8%、99.2%、97.1% 和 98.5%(每种血清型 752 名参与者)。在四个 队列研究 中,29/1,468 名参与者在第 270 天出现 SAE(合并风险 2.0%,95% CI 1.4–2.8)。两项研究对疼痛和头痛的估计都非常不精确。结论:最终制剂 TAK-003 在选定的成人试验人群中显示出较高的短期血清阳性率。SAE 风险不受控制,无法建立相对安全性。确定性很低或非常低,并且推断受到研究规模、替代结果和不受控制的安全性数据的限制。

papers.title: Divergências in silico nos sítios de anelamento de RT-qPCR do vírus da dengue e correção do conjunto afetado In silico divergences at RT-qPCR annealing sites of dengue virus and correction of the affected primer-probe set
papers.abstract: Dengue comprises four serotypes with wide genetic diversity, and mutations in the regions recognised by primers and probes may compromise the reliability of RT-qPCR assays. This study assessed the impact of such divergences on the annealing sites of a fourplex RT-qPCR assay for serotype-specific detection of DENV, published in 2005, and proposed a corrected set for the most affected serotype. This is a descriptive-analytical study with an in silico approach. Twenty-four complete genomes, six per serotype, were retrieved from NCBI and formed the main panel, expanded to 45 DENV-3 and 48 DENV-2 genomes for the detailed analyses. The twelve oligonucleotides of the assay were located in each genome by local alignment against both strands, with coordinates validated against the positions published in the original protocol. Divergences were observed in all twelve oligonucleotides. Seven events fell within the five bases of the 3′ end of primers, distributed across DENV-2, DENV-3 and DENV-4, with none in DENV-1. The sense primer D3-F proved the most compromised component, since the substitution at position 18, two bases from the 3′ end, was present in 45 of the 45 DENV-3 genomes analysed, from different countries and collection periods, so that the published oligonucleotide shows perfect pairing in none of them. Complete redesign of the DENV-3 set proved unfeasible. Of the 10,707 genome positions, 8,268 (77.2%) are conserved, yet only 23 stretches reach 18 nucleotides and merely three can host an oligonucleotide able to discriminate the remaining serotypes, separated from one another by thousands of bases. In the 3′ untranslated region, all 25 sets generated contained at least one component identical to another serotype. Correction of the existing oligonucleotides through degenerate bases was therefore adopted, raising perfect pairing of D3-F from none to 44 of the 45 genomes. It is concluded that intra-serotypic conservation and serotype specificity compete for the same genomic region and that monitoring of diagnostic sites should be incorporated into routine genomic surveillance.
authors: Maria Bárbara de Holanda Cavalcante Ubaldo Monteiro e Barbosa

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the impact of genetic divergence on the annealing sites of a fourplex RT-qPCR assay for dengue virus serotype-specific detection. The authors found that mutations in these regions may compromise the reliability of the assay. They observed divergences in all twelve oligonucleotides, with the most significant changes affecting DENV-3. papers.abstract_zh: 登革热包含具有广泛遗传多样性的四种血清型,引物和探针识别区域中的 突变 可能会损害 RT-qPCR 检测的可靠性。这项研究评估了这种差异对 2005 年发表的用于 DENV 血清型特异性检测的四重 RT-qPCR 检测的退火位点的影响,并针对受影响最严重的血清型提出了校正集。这是一项采用计算机方法的描述性分析研究。从 NCBI 检索了 24 个完整的 基因组,每种血清型 6 个,并形成了主面板,扩展到 45 个 DENV-3 和 48 个 DENV-2 基因组 以进行详细分析。通过针对两条链的局部比对,将测定的 12 个寡核苷酸定位在每个 基因组 中,并根据原始方案中发布的位置验证坐标。在所有十二种寡核苷酸中观察到差异。7 个事件落在引物 3' 端的 5 个碱基内,分布在 DENV-2、DENV-3 和 DENV-4 中,DENV-1 中没有。有义引物 D3-F 被证明是最受影响的组件,因为来自 3' 端的两个碱基的位置 18 的取代存在于分析的 45 个 DENV-3 基因组 中的 45 个中,来自不同的国家和收集时期,因此所发表的寡核苷酸在其中没有一个显示出完美的配对。事实证明,对 DENV-3 装置进行彻底重新设计是不可行的。在 10,707 个 基因组 位置中,有 8,268 个 (77.2%) 是保守的,但只有 23 个序列达到 18 个核苷酸,并且只有 3 个 宿主 寡核苷酸能够区分其余血清型,彼此之间相隔数千个碱基。在 3' 非翻译区中,生成的所有 25 个组均包含至少一个与另一种血清型相同的成分。因此,通过简并碱基对现有寡核苷酸进行了修正,将 D3-F 的完美配对从无配对提高到 45 个 基因组 中的 44 个。结论是,血清型内保守性和血清型特异性竞争相同的基因组区域,并且诊断位点的监测应纳入常规 基因组监测 中。

papers.title: UNCOVERING THE POTENTIAL OF NIRAGA TEA POLYHERBALTM AS AN ANTIOXIDANT AND ANTIVIRAL AGENT AGAINST DENGUE: INSIGHTS FROM IN VITRO AND IN SILICO APPROACHES
papers.abstract: Dengue is a vector-borne disease with a high health burden in tropical regions, yet no specific antiviral therapy is currently available. This study aimed to investigate the antioxidant activity, cytotoxicity, and antiviral activity against dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV-2) of the Niraga Tea PolyherbalTM formulation and performed phytochemical profiling and molecular docking. GC‒MS and FT‒IR analyses were used to analyze the profiles and structures of bioactive compounds; antioxidant activity was evaluated using the DPPH, ABTS, and FRAP methods; dengue antiviral activity was evaluated using the Viral ToxGlo assay; and cytotoxicity was evaluated using Vero cells in an MTT assay. Molecular docking evaluations of the compounds targeting the DENV-2 NS5 protein in silico. GC‒MS characterization revealed 100 compounds, predominantly methyl oleate (69.60%) and ethyl pentadecanoate (20.84%), along with quercetin (0.46%) and epigallocatechin gallate (0.19%). FT-IR analysis confirmed that phenolic hydroxyl groups were the dominant functional groups. DPPH, ABTS, and FRAP assays revealed IC50 values of 20.79, 21.34, and 18.80 μg/mL, respectively. MTT assays of Vero cells yielded a CC50 value of 1207 μg/mL. Niraga Tea PolyherbalTM significantly inhibited the cytopathic effects (F= 42.50; p=0.005), with an EC50 of 10.32 μg/mL and a selectivity index (SI) of 116.96 against DENV-2. Molecular binding studies of methyl oleate and ethyl pentadecanoate to DENV-2 NS5 revealed weak binding affinities (ΔG -3.95 to -4.31 kcal/mol), which were weaker than those observed with more potent in vitro compounds. In conclusion, Niraga Tea PolyherbalTM has the potential to be developed as a candidate phytopharmaceutical for dengue antiviral therapy with a high safety profile against host cells.

papers.title: Glycosylation of the Premembrane Protein Is Required for Dengue Virus Replication in Both C6/36 and Vero Cells
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito-borne, positive sense, single-stranded RNA virus that includes four serotypes (DENV1-4) that are further divided into distinct genotypes within a serotype. DENV causes approximately 100 million human infections each year. DENV virions encode a capisd surrounded by a lipid bilayer that encodes two glycoproteins, E and prM. During virion maturation, the premembrane protein (prM) is cleaved to form a mature virion, which includes partially mature and fully mature particles. The maturity state of the DENV virion affects both the infectivity of DENVs and the ability of antibodies to neutralize the virus. The prM glycoprotein is glycosylated and highly conserved across all DENVs. In particular, the N-linked glycosylation site at position 69 is present in over 99% of DENV genomes. In this manuscript, we investigated the importance of the N69 glycosylation site by generating both DENV2 and DENV4 loss-of-function viruses. These N69 glycosylation knockout viruses were generated by introducing a single amino acid mutation at site 69. Neither mutant virus had detectable titers despite multiple passages in vitro. To further investigate the importance of the glycosylation site, we generated another variation in which the N-linked glycosylation site was repositioned to a site proximal to residue 69. One of these proximal-glycosylation mutants showed viral replication at levels that approached wild-type (WT) DENV strains. Overall, this study demonstrated the importance of retaining an N-linked glycan on the prM protein at position 69 for DENV infectivity of mosquito cells and that inserting a glycosylation site in close proximity to position 69 may restore infectivity in some DENV4 strains.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨 登革病毒 (DENV) prM 蛋白上的 N69 糖基化位点对病毒复制和感染性的重要性。登革病毒 是一种蚊媒、正义、单链 RNA 病毒,包括四种血清型 (DENV1-4),在血清型内进一步分为不同的基因型。

elements_zh.methods: 研究人员通过在 69 位点引入单个氨基酸 突变 来创建 N69 糖基化敲除病毒。然后,他们评估了蚊子细胞中的病毒复制,并评估了这些突变病毒与野生型 DENV 毒株相比的感染性。
elements_zh.main_results: 尽管在体外多次传代,两种 N69 糖基化敲除病毒都没有可检测到的滴度。其中一种近端糖基化突变体的病毒复制水平接近野生型 (WT) DENV 毒株。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出结论,在 prM 蛋白 69 位保留 N 连接聚糖对于蚊子细胞的 DENV 感染性至关重要。他们还指出,在 69 位附近插入糖基化位点可能会恢复某些 DENV4 菌株的感染性。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外实验,可能无法完全代表体内条件。证据是中等的,因为它基于实验室观察,没有临床或流行病学数据。

papers.title_zh: C6/36 和 Vero 细胞中的 登革病毒 复制需要前膜蛋白的糖基化
papers.source_body_en: Dengue virus (DENV) is a mosquito-borne, positive sense, single-stranded RNA virus that includes four serotypes (DENV1-4) that are further divided into distinct genotypes within a serotype. DENV causes approximately 100 million human infections each year. DENV virions encode a capisd surrounded by a lipid bilayer that encodes two glycoproteins, E and prM. During virion maturation, the premembrane protein (prM) is cleaved to form a mature virion, which includes partially mature and fully mature particles. The maturity state of the DENV virion affects both the infectivity of DENVs and the ability of antibodies to neutralize the virus. The prM glycoprotein is glycosylated and highly conserved across all DENVs. In particular, the N-linked glycosylation site at position 69 is present in over 99% of DENV genomes. In this manuscript, we investigated the importance of the N69 glycosylation site by generating both DENV2 and DENV4 loss-of-function viruses. These N69 glycosylation knockout viruses were generated by introducing a single amino acid mutation at site 69. Neither mutant virus had detectable titers despite multiple passages in vitro. To further investigate the importance of the glycosylation site, we generated another variation in which the N-linked glycosylation site was repositioned to a site proximal to residue 69. One of these proximal-glycosylation mutants showed viral replication at levels that approached wild-type (WT) DENV strains. Overall, this study demonstrated the importance of retaining an N-linked glycan on the prM protein at position 69 for DENV infectivity of mosquito cells and that inserting a glycosylation site in close proximity to position 69 may restore infectivity in some DENV4 strains.

papers.title: Spatial Mapping of Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever Cases and Primary Healthcare Accessibility in the Oesapa Health Center Catchment, Kupang City, Indonesia
papers.abstract: Dengue hemorrhagic fever remains a recurrent public health problem in tropical cities, where localized transmission and unequal access to primary healthcare can delay early case management. This study aimed to map the distribution of dengue cases and evaluate the spatial accessibility of existing community health services in the Oesapa Health Center catchment, Kupang City, Indonesia. A descriptive quantitative design was combined with geographic information system analysis. Secondary dengue surveillance records for 2023, field-verified case coordinates, administrative boundaries, and health-facility locations were integrated in ArcGIS. Case distribution was summarized by sex, age group, and kelurahan, while a 3,000-m service buffer was used to assess potential reach from Oesapa Health Center to recorded case locations. Kupang City reported 199 dengue cases in 2023, and the Oesapa Health Center catchment accounted for the highest health-center total, with 35 cases or 17.6% of the citywide burden. Within the catchment, cases were concentrated in Oesapa and Lasiana, which together contributed 25 cases or 71.4% of the local total. Adults aged 18-59 years represented the largest age group with 21 cases or 60.0%, while female patients accounted for 57.1% of cases. Buffer analysis indicated that 29 of 35 cases, or 82.9%, were located within the 3,000-m potential service catchment, leaving six cases outside the primary buffer. The findings show that micro-scale dengue mapping can identify priority neighborhoods and reveal residual access gaps within an apparently well-served urban health-center area.

papers.title_zh: 印度尼西亚古邦市 Oesapa 卫生中心流域登革出血热病例和初级医疗保健可及性的空间测绘
papers.source_body_en: Dengue hemorrhagic fever remains a recurrent public health problem in tropical cities, where localized transmission and unequal access to primary healthcare can delay early case management. This study aimed to map the distribution of dengue cases and evaluate the spatial accessibility of existing community health services in the Oesapa Health Center catchment, Kupang City, Indonesia. A descriptive quantitative design was combined with geographic information system analysis. Secondary dengue surveillance records for 2023, field-verified case coordinates, administrative boundaries, and health-facility locations were integrated in ArcGIS. Case distribution was summarized by sex, age group, and kelurahan, while a 3,000-m service buffer was used to assess potential reach from Oesapa Health Center to recorded case locations. Kupang City reported 199 dengue cases in 2023, and the Oesapa Health Center catchment accounted for the highest health-center total, with 35 cases or 17.6% of the citywide burden. Within the catchment, cases were concentrated in Oesapa and Lasiana, which together contributed 25 cases or 71.4% of the local total. Adults aged 18-59 years represented the largest age group with 21 cases or 60.0%, while female patients accounted for 57.1% of cases. Buffer analysis indicated that 29 of 35 cases, or 82.9%, were located within the 3,000-m potential service catchment, leaving six cases outside the primary buffer. The findings show that micro-scale dengue mapping can identify priority neighborhoods and reveal residual access gaps within an apparently well-served urban health-center area.

papers.title: Impact of DENV-ZIKV cross-reactivity in Southeast Asia: A modelling study in Thailand
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) is endemic across Southeast Asia (SEA), where a large proportion of adults have been infected. Zika virus (ZIKV) has circulated in the region for decades but the extent of transmission remains unclear. Prior infection with one virus can protect against or enhance infection with the other, but the population-level consequences are unknown. We developed an age-structured DENV-ZIKV model with nine cross-reactivity assumptions combining cross-protection and subsequent enhancement, and simulated sustained co-circulation under changing Thai demography. Through cross-reactivity, DENV strongly shaped ZIKV transmission, whereas ZIKV had little effect on DENV transmission. Under cross-protection, ZIKV transmission occurred as infrequent outbreaks without changes in long-term ZIKV burden. When prior DENV infection enhanced both ZIKV infection and symptomatic risk, this burden roughly doubled. Population ageing raised the mean age of DENV and ZIKV cases by over 20 years, more than cross-reactivity did. Simulated ZIKV case ages were closer to those reported in Thailand in 2019-2023 under enhancement of ZIKV infection and symptoms. Over half of individuals aged 15-49 years remained ZIKV-naive under all assumptions, leaving many pregnancies at risk of congenital Zika syndrome. Interpreting ZIKV case counts in SEA requires joint consideration of cross-reactivity, demographic change and case detection.

papers.title_zh: DENV-ZIKV 交叉反应对东南亚的影响:泰国的模型研究
papers.source_body_en: Dengue virus (DENV) is endemic across Southeast Asia (SEA), where a large proportion of adults have been infected. Zika virus (ZIKV) has circulated in the region for decades but the extent of transmission remains unclear. Prior infection with one virus can protect against or enhance infection with the other, but the population-level consequences are unknown. We developed an age-structured DENV-ZIKV model with nine cross-reactivity assumptions combining cross-protection and subsequent enhancement, and simulated sustained co-circulation under changing Thai demography. Through cross-reactivity, DENV strongly shaped ZIKV transmission, whereas ZIKV had little effect on DENV transmission. Under cross-protection, ZIKV transmission occurred as infrequent outbreaks without changes in long-term ZIKV burden. When prior DENV infection enhanced both ZIKV infection and symptomatic risk, this burden roughly doubled. Population ageing raised the mean age of DENV and ZIKV cases by over 20 years, more than cross-reactivity did. Simulated ZIKV case ages were closer to those reported in Thailand in 2019-2023 under enhancement of ZIKV infection and symptoms. Over half of individuals aged 15-49 years remained ZIKV-naive under all assumptions, leaving many pregnancies at risk of congenital Zika syndrome. Interpreting ZIKV case counts in SEA requires joint consideration of cross-reactivity, demographic change and case detection.

papers.title: Impacto epidemiológico del dengue y del chikungunya en zonas urbanas: revisión sistemática Epidemiological impact of dengue and chikungunya in urban areas: a systematic review
papers.abstract: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios. Resultados: la incidencia mundial del dengue aumentó desde 1990, con diferencias regionales marcadas y alta carga en América Latina. El chikungunya se expandió por las Américas desde 2013 y produjo brotes urbanos explosivos, con manifestaciones articulares persistentes. La urbanización, la expansión de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus y la resistencia a insecticidas favorecieron la transmisión. Destacan como estrategias las nuevas vacunas y el control vectorial integrado. Conclusión: ambas arbovirosis son una carga creciente para las ciudades tropicales y subtropicales y exigen vigilancia y control sostenidos.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review synthesizes the epidemiological impact of dengue and chikungunya in urban areas. The review, conducted between 2012 and 2025, included 15 studies from PubMed and SciELO. Key findings indicate a global increase in dengue incidence since 1990, with significant regional variations and a high burden in Latin America. Chikungunya expanded across the Americas starting in 2013, causing explosive urban outbreaks with persistent joint manifestations. Urbanization, the spread of Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, and insecticide resistance are identified as factors that facilitated transmission. The review highlights the need for sustained surveillance and control measures, emphasizing the potential of new vaccines and integrated vector control as strategies. The evidence suggests that both arboviruses pose a growing threat to tropical and subtropical urban populations.

papers.source_body_en: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios. Resultados: la incidencia mundial del dengue aumentó desde 1990, con diferencias regionales marcadas y alta carga en América Latina. Destacan como estrategias las nuevas vacunas y el control vectorial integrado. Conclusión: ambas arbovirosis son una carga creciente para las ciudades tropicales y subtropicales y exigen vigilancia y control sostenidos.

papers.title: Estrategias de prevención del dengue en comunidades urbanas: revisión sistemática Dengue prevention strategies in urban communities: a systematic review
papers.abstract: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre la efectividad de las estrategias de prevención del dengue en comunidades urbanas y su aplicabilidad al contexto ecuatoriano. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios: revisiones sistemáticas con y sin metaanálisis, estudios en Ecuador, intervenciones comunitarias y una evaluación económica. Resultados: el control químico aislado redujo los índices entomológicos sin efecto demostrado sobre la transmisión. El manejo ambiental con participación comunitaria, las mallas en las viviendas y las cubiertas de recipientes mostraron los resultados más favorables. El almacenamiento de agua, la percepción del riesgo y la falta de servicios básicos condicionaron la prevención en Ecuador. Conclusión: la prevención del dengue urbano requiere estrategias integradas, comunitarias y sostenidas, con vigilancia epidemiológica y mejoras de los servicios básicos.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review aims to synthesize evidence on the effectiveness of dengue prevention strategies in urban communities and assess their applicability to the Ecuadorian context.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A systematic review was conducted using PubMed and SciELO databases from 2012 to 2025. The evidence includes 15 studies: systematic reviews with and without meta-analyses, studies conducted in Ecuador, community interventions, and an economic evaluation.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review found that integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, including environmental management, window screens, and covered water containers, showed the most favorable results in dengue prevention. However, chemical control alone reduced entomological indices without demonstrated impact on transmission.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights that factors such as water storage practices, risk perception, and lack of basic services influenced prevention effectiveness in Ecuador. There is no explicit mention of conflicting findings or heterogeneity in the results.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review concludes that dengue prevention in urban areas requires integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, along with epidemiological surveillance and improvements in basic services.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review evaluates dengue prevention strategies in urban communities, focusing on their effectiveness and applicability in Ecuador. The evidence base includes 15 studies from PubMed and SciELO, spanning 2012 to 2025, encompassing systematic reviews, community interventions, and economic evaluations. Key findings indicate that integrated, community-based, and sustained strategies, such as environmental management, window screens, and covered water containers, yielded the most favorable outcomes. However, chemical control alone reduced entomological indices without clear evidence of impact on transmission. The review emphasizes the need for strategies that incorporate epidemiological surveillance and improvements in basic services to effectively prevent dengue in urban settings. The study also notes that factors like water storage practices, risk perception, and lack of basic services influenced prevention success in Ecuador. The implications suggest a focus on community engagement and long-term, sustainable interventions to address dengue in urban populations.

analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 审查得出的结论是,城市地区的登革热预防需要综合、基于社区和持续的战略,以及流行病学 监测 和改善基本服务。

papers.title: An Analysis of the SIR Model and Stability of Dengue Fever Spread in Tangerang Regency
papers.abstract: Penyakit yang berbahaya dan bisa menyebabkan kematian jika tidak ditangani dengan tepat di Indonesia salah satunya Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD). Demam Berdarah Dengue menjadi penyakit yang saat ini berkembang di dunia dan masih menjadi masalah kebanyakan masyarakat di Indonesia khususnya di Kabupaten Tangerang. Dalam mengatasi penyebaran penyakit ini, analisis model matematika SIR dapat digunakan untuk pemahaman dan memprediksi dinamika penyebaran penyakit Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD). Jenis penelitian ini adalah studi kepustakaan dan penelitian kuantitatif. Tujuan penelitian ini untuk mengetahui model penyebaran penyakit Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) menggunakan model SIR, analisis dinamik, titik ekuilibrium, kestabilan titik ekuilibrium dan simulasi numerik model matematika SIR pada penyebaran penyakit Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) di Kabupaten Tangerang. Hasil penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa model matematika SIR efektif dalam memodelkan dan menganalisis kesatbilan penyebaran penyakit penyakit Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) di Kabupaten Tangerang. Penelitian ini memberikan konstribusi penting dalam menanggulangi dan mengetahui kestabilan penyebaran penyakit.

papers.title: Arboviroses e suas manifestações musculoesqueléticas subsídios para o diagnóstico diferencial entre dengue, Chikungunya e Zika
papers.abstract: Introdução: Dengue, Chikungunya e Zika, transmitidas pelo Aedes aegypti, cocirculam no Brasil e compartilham manifestações iniciais, o que dificulta o diagnóstico diferencial.Objetivo: Caracterizar o quadro clínico de dengue, Chikungunya e Zika, com ênfase nos sintomas musculoesqueléticos e constitucionais, e sistematizar elementos para o diagnóstico diferencial. Métodos: Revisão narrativa nas bases SciELO, LILACS e PubMed/MEDLINE, com publicações de 2012 a 2026, complementada por documentos do Ministério da Saúde e recomendações da Sociedade Brasileira de Reumatologia. Resultados: Na dengue, predominam febre alta por dois a sete dias, mialgia intensa e artralgia leve, com risco de extravasamento plasmático na defervescência. Na Chikungunya, mais de 90% dos pacientes apresentam poliatralgia simétrica e incapacitante, com edema e tenossinovite, e cerca de metade evolui para doença crônica, por vezes com artrite erosiva. Na Zika, a febre é baixa ou ausente, o exantema pruriginoso é precoce, a conjuntivite é frequente e a artralgia é discreta; a infecção congênita pode cursar com artrogripose. Trombocitopenia sugere dengue, e linfopenia, Chikungunya. O RT-PCR é indicado é indicado até o quinto dia e a sorologia a partir do sexto, com reação cruzada entre flavivírus. Anti-inflamatórios e corticosteroides devem ser evitados até que a dengue seja afastada. Conclusão: O padrão musculoesquelético, associado ao comportamento da febre e do exantema, orienta o diagnóstico diferencial nos primeiros dias; a cronificação da Chikungunya exige seguimento estruturado e manejo da dor conforme a fase da doença.
authors: Mateus Dornelas Mitchell Paiva De Almeida
Maria Helena Queiroz de Araújo Mariano
papers.journal: Brazilian Journal of Implantology and Health Sciences

Resultados: Na dengue, predominam febre alta por dois a sete dias, mialgia intensa e artralgia leve, com risco de extravasamento plasmático na defervescência. Na Chikungunya, mais de 90% dos pacientes apresentam poliatralgia simétrica e incapacitante, com edema e tenossinovite, e cerca de metade evolui para doença crônica, por vezes com artrite erosiva. Na Zika, a febre é baixa ou ausente, o exantema pruriginoso é precoce, a conjuntivite é frequente e a artralgia é discreta; a infecção congênita pode cursar com artrogripose. Trombocitopenia sugere dengue, e linfopenia, Chikungunya. O RT-PCR é indicado é indicado até o quinto dia e a sorologia a partir do sexto, com reação cruzada entre flavivírus. Anti-inflamatórios e corticosteroides devem ser evitados até que a dengue seja afastada. Conclusão: O padrão musculoesquelético, associado ao comportamento da febre e do exantema, orienta o diagnóstico diferencial nos primeiros dias; a cronificação da Chikungunya exige seguimento estruturado e manejo da dor conforme a fase da doença.
authors: Mateus Dornelas Mitchell Paiva de Almeida
Maria Helena Queiroz de Araújo Mariano

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to characterize the clinical picture of dengue, Chikungunya, and Zika, with emphasis on musculoskeletal and constitutional symptoms, and to systematize elements for differential diagnosis. The scientific/public-health problem is the difficulty in differentiating these arboviroses due to their overlapping initial manifestations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A narrative review was conducted using SciELO, LILACS, and PubMed/MEDLINE databases from 2012 to 2026, supplemented by Ministry of Health documents and recommendations from the Brazilian Society of Rheumatology.
analysis.methods: The review included RT-PCR for dengue until the fifth day and serology from the sixth day, with cross-reactivity between flaviviruses. Anti-inflammatory and corticosteroid use was advised to be avoided until dengue was ruled out.
analysis.main_results: Dengue presents with high fever for two to seven days, intense myalgia, and mild arthralgia, with risk of plasma extravasation during defervescence. Chikungunya is characterized by more than 90% of patients with symmetrical and incapacitating polyarthralgia, edema, and tenosynovitis, with about half evolving to chronic disease, sometimes with erosive arthritis. Zika has low or absent fever, pruriginous exanthem, frequent conjunctivitis, and mild arthralgia; congenital infection may result in arthrogryposis. Trombocytopenia suggests dengue, and lymphopenia suggests Chikungunya.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study interpreted that the musculoskeletal pattern, associated with fever and exanthem behavior, guides differential diagnosis in the early days; chronic Chikungunya requires structured follow-up and pain management according to the disease phase.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment of these arboviroses, particularly in the early stages, and highlight the importance of distinguishing between them to prevent misdiagnosis and inappropriate treatment.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on narrative review and the absence of randomized controlled trials, which may affect the strength of the evidence. The evidence is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to differentiate dengue, Chikungunya, and Zika based on clinical manifestations, particularly musculoskeletal symptoms. It reviewed literature from 2012 to 2026 and highlighted the importance of early diagnosis to prevent mismanagement of these arboviroses.

papers.title_zh: 蚊媒病毒感染及其肌肉骨骼表现:登革热、基孔肯雅热与寨卡病毒的鉴别诊断依据

papers.abstract_zh: 引言:登革热、基孔肯雅热和寨卡热均由埃及伊蚊传播,在巴西同时流行,且具有相似的初期表现,这给鉴别诊断带来困难。目标:描述登革热、基孔肯雅热和寨卡热的临床特征,特别是肌肉骨骼和全身症状,并系统化鉴别诊断要素。方法:通过SciELO、LILACS和PubMed/MEDLINE数据库进行叙述性综述,时间范围为2012年至2026年,同时结合卫生部文件和巴西风湿病学会的建议。结果:登革热表现为高热持续2至7天,伴有剧烈肌肉疼痛和轻度关节痛,退热期有血浆渗漏的风险。基孔肯雅热则超过90%的患者出现对称性且致残的多关节痛,伴有水肿和腱鞘炎,约有一半患者发展为慢性疾病,有时表现为侵蚀性关节炎。寨卡热则以低热或无热为主,早期出现瘙痒性皮疹,常见结膜炎,关节痛较轻;先天性感染可能导致关节僵硬。血小板减少提示登革热,淋巴细胞减少提示基孔肯雅热。RT-PCR适用于登革热诊断,建议在发病后第五天内进行,而血清学检测则从第六天开始,且存在黄病毒属之间的交叉反应。在排除登革热之前,应避免使用抗炎药和糖皮质激素。结论:肌肉骨骼表现模式,结合发热和皮疹的发展情况,有助于早期鉴别诊断;基孔肯雅热的慢性化需要结构化的随访和根据疾病阶段进行疼痛管理。科学与公共卫生意义:这些发现可为登革热、基孔肯雅热和寨卡热的诊断、治疗和监测提供依据,特别是在早期阶段,强调区分这些蚊媒病毒的重要性,以防止误诊和不当治疗。局限性与证据强度:本研究依赖叙述性综述,缺乏随机对照试验,这可能影响证据的强度。证据等级为中等。

papers.title: DENGUE ALÉM DOS GRANDES CENTROS: SÉRIE HISTÓRICA DE 12 ANOS EM UM MUNICÍPIO BRASILEIRO DE PEQUENO PORTE
papers.abstract: A dengue constitui importante problema de saúde pública no Brasil, devido à sua elevada capacidade de disseminação, recorrência epidêmica, impacto assistencial e influência de fatores ambientais, sociais e climáticos. Este estudo analisou o perfil epidemiológico e endêmico da dengue no município de Padre Paraíso, Minas Gerais, entre 2014 e 2025, em comparação com o cenário estadual. Trata-se de um estudo ecológico de série histórica, com abordagem quantitativa, realizado a partir de dados do SINAN/TABNET/DATASUS e do IBGE. Foram analisados indicadores epidemiológicos, informações sociodemográficas, desfechos clínicos e circulação sorotípica do vírus da dengue. A endemicidade foi avaliada por meio de canal endêmico baseado em mediana e quartis dos coeficientes de incidência por semana epidemiológica considerando o período 2014 a 2025. O município apresentou ciclos epidêmicos sincronizados ao cenário estadual, porém com maior intensidade proporcional e padrão sazonal recorrente entre as semanas epidemiológicas 8 e 25. Observou-se prevalência de casos para o sexo feminino, faixa etária de 20 a 59 anos e em indivíduos pardos. Não houve registro de óbitos por dengue no município, enquanto Minas Gerais apresentou óbitos em todos os anos.

papers.title_zh: 登革热不止于大城市:巴西一个小型市镇12年的历史系列研究
papers.source_body_en: A dengue constitui importante problema de saúde pública no Brasil, devido à sua elevada capacidade de disseminação, recorrência epidêmica, impacto assistencial e influência de fatores ambientais, sociais e climáticos. Este estudo analisou o perfil epidemiológico e endêmico da dengue no município de Padre Paraíso, Minas Gerais, entre 2014 e 2025, em comparação com o cenário estadual. Trata-se de um estudo ecológico de série histórica, com abordagem quantitativa, realizado a partir de dados do SINAN/TABNET/DATASUS e do IBGE. Foram analisados indicadores epidemiológicos, informações sociodemográficas, desfechos clínicos e circulação sorotípica do vírus da dengue. A endemicidade foi avaliada por meio de canal endêmico baseado em mediana e quartis dos coeficientes de incidência por semana epidemiológica considerando o período 2014 a 2025. O município apresentou ciclos epidêmicos sincronizados ao cenário estadual, porém com maior intensidade proporcional e padrão sazonal recorrente entre as semanas epidemiológicas 8 e 25. Observou-se prevalência de casos para o sexo feminino, faixa etária de 20 a 59 anos e em indivíduos pardos. Não houve registro de óbitos por dengue no município, enquanto Minas Gerais apresentou óbitos em todos os anos.
papers.abstract_zh: 登革热是巴西重要的公共卫生问题,由于其高度的传播能力、疫情反复、医疗负担以及环境、社会和气候因素的影响。本研究分析了2014年至2025年间巴西米纳斯吉拉斯州Padre Paraíso市镇的登革热流行病学和地方性特征,并与州级情况进行了比较。这是一项基于历史数据的生态学研究,采用定量分析方法,数据来源于SINAN/TABNET/DATASUS和IBGE。研究分析了流行病学指标、社会人口学信息、临床结局以及登革病毒血清型的循环情况。地方性通过基于中位数和四分位数的发病率中位数和四分位数计算的流行病学通道进行评估,时间范围为2014年至2025年。该市镇的疫情周期与州级情况同步,但发病率比例更高,且在流行病学周8至25之间呈现出反复的季节性模式。观察到病例主要集中在女性、20至59岁年龄组以及混血种人中。该市镇未记录登革热死亡病例,而米纳斯吉拉斯州每年均有登革热死亡病例。

papers.title: Nationwide evaluation of district-informed bottom-up and direct national approaches for one-week-ahead forecasting of dengue hospital admissions in Bangladesh
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue places recurrent pressure on surveillance and hospital services in Bangladesh, yet most Bangladesh-focused forecasting studies have used national or temporally aggregated data. Whether retaining district-level information before national aggregation provides additional value for short-range forecasting remains uncertain. This study evaluated district-informed and direct national approaches for one-week-ahead forecasting of reported dengue hospital admissions across all 64 districts of Bangladesh. A nationwide surveillance–meteorological panel for 2022–2025 comprised 93,504 district-day observations aggregated into 13,312 complete district-week records. Admissions were organized by reporting district, not patient residence. A single pooled district-week Light Gradient Boosting Machine (LightGBM) generated district-specific forecasts that were summed to obtain national predictions. This bottom-up approach was compared with direct national LightGBM, a negative binomial generalized additive model, one-week persistence, and hierarchical forecasting benchmarks. Model development was temporally ordered: 2024 was used for validation and model selection, finalized specifications were refitted using all pre-2025 model-ready data, and models remained fixed throughout the 52-week 2025 evaluation. Because model specifications were revised during peer review after initial 2025 results were known, 2025 was held out from model fitting but is not treated as an entirely untouched test set. Bottom-up LightGBM achieved the lowest observed national point error in 2025 (MAE = 239.37; RMSE = 380.27; wMAPE = 12.10%; R2 = 0.9625), compared with the direct national negative binomial generalized additive model (wMAPE = 14.85%), one-week persistence (15.65%), and direct national LightGBM (18.67%). At district-week level, improvement over persistence was modest (wMAPE = 28.34% vs. All three primary 95% circular block-bootstrap confidence intervals for the primary national wMAPE differences crossed zero, and adjusted predictive-accuracy tests did not establish statistical superiority. Hierarchical reconciliation did not reduce national point error below the unreconciled bottom-up forecast. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) identified recent admissions as the dominant predictive signal, while additional analyses showed geographic heterogeneity in forecast-error magnitude. The empirical 95% residual-based uncertainty interval covered 49 of 52 held-out weeks (94.23%). District-informed bottom-up forecasting achieved the lowest observed national point error while retaining subnational forecast information, but its advantage over strong comparators remained statistically uncertain. Prospective multi-season validation is required before routine early-warning use.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热对孟加拉国的监测和医院服务造成持续压力,但大多数以孟加拉国为中心的预测研究都使用了国家级或时间聚合的数据。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了基于区级信息和直接国家级方法在孟加拉国所有64个区的一周期前登革热住院病例预测。
elements_zh.methods: 一个单一的区级周数据池Light Gradient Boosting Machine(LightGBM)生成了区级特定的预测,并将这些预测汇总以获得国家级预测。本研究采用前瞻性多季节验证方法,其中2024年用于验证和模型选择,最终的模型规格使用所有2025年前的模型可用数据重新拟合。
elements_zh.main_results: 自下而上的LightGBM在2025年实现了最低的观察到的国家级点误差(MAE = 239.37;RMSE = 380.27;wMAPE = 12.10%;R2 = 0.9625),与直接国家级负二项广义可加模型(wMAPE = 14.85%)、一周期持续预测(15.65%)和直接国家级LightGBM(18.67%)相比。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 基于区级信息的自下而上预测实现了最低的观察到的国家级点误差,同时保留了次国家级预测信息,但其相对于强比较对象的优势仍存在统计不确定性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,在进行国家级聚合之前保留区级信息可能为登革热住院病例的短期预测提供额外价值,这可能有助于制定更具针对性的公共卫生干预措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的设计局限性包括:在初步2025年结果已知后,模型规格在同行评审过程中进行了修订;主要的国家级wMAPE差异的95%圆块自举置信区间均跨越了零点,表明存在统计不确定性。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 登革热对孟加拉国的监测和医院服务造成持续压力,但大多数以孟加拉国为中心的预测研究都使用了国家级或时间聚合的数据。在进行国家级聚合之前保留区级信息是否能为短期预测提供额外价值仍不确定。本研究评估了基于区级信息和直接国家级方法在孟加拉国所有64个区的一周期前登革热住院病例预测。2022-2025年的全国监测-气象学面板包含93,504个区级日观测数据,汇总为13,312个完整的区级周记录。病例报告按报告区组织,而非患者居住地。一个单一的区级周数据池Light Gradient Boosting Machine(LightGBM)生成了区级特定的预测,并将这些预测汇总以获得国家级预测。该自下而上的方法与直接国家级LightGBM、负二项广义可加模型、一周期持续预测以及分层预测基准进行了比较。模型开发按时间顺序进行:2024年用于验证和模型选择,最终的模型规格使用所有2025年前的模型可用数据重新拟合,模型在整个2025年52周的评估期间保持不变。由于在初步2025年结果已知后,模型规格在同行评审过程中进行了修订,因此2025年未被纳入模型拟合,但不被视为完全未受干扰的测试集。自下而上的LightGBM在2025年实现了最低的国家级点误差(MAE = 239.37;RMSE = 380.27;wMAPE = 12.10%;R2 = 0.9625),与直接国家级负二项广义可加模型(wMAPE = 14.85%)、一周期持续预测(15.65%)和直接国家级LightGBM(18.67%)相比。在区级周层面,与持续预测相比的改进较为有限(wMAPE = 28.34% vs. 15.65%)。三个主要的全国wMAPE差异的95%圆块自举置信区间均跨越了零点,调整后的预测准确性测试未能确立统计上的优势。分层协调并未将国家级点误差降低到未协调的自下而上预测之下。SHapley Additive exPlanations(SHAP)识别出近期病例是主要的预测信号,而进一步分析表明,预测误差的大小在地理上存在异质性。基于残差的实证95%不确定性区间覆盖了52个未被使用的周中的49个(94.23%)。基于区级信息的自下而上预测实现了最低的观察到的国家级点误差,同时保留了次国家级预测信息,但其相对于强比较对象的优势仍存在统计不确定性。在常规早期预警使用之前,需要进行前瞻性多季节验证。

papers.title: A study of the global properties and optimal control of dengue disease transmission model
papers.abstract: In this work, we formulate a nonlinear system of differential equations that models the transmission dynamics of dengue fever. The model exhibits the classical threshold behavior. We prove that when the basic reproduction number is less than one, the disease-free equilibrium is locally and globally asymptotically stable and when the basic reproduction number is greater than one the endemic equilibrium is globally asymptotically stable under certain conditions. The stability of equilibria is derived through the use of Lyapunov stability theory and LaSalle's invariance principle. In addition we formulate an optimal control problem involving preventive measures, the investment in vaccination of susceptible humans and the investment related to insecticide treatment. Numerical simulations are provided to illustrate the theoretical results.
papers.journal: Analele Universității din Oradea, fascicola Matematica

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to model the transmission dynamics of dengue fever and understand its global properties through a nonlinear system of differential equations. The research addresses the need for improved mathematical frameworks to analyze dengue disease spread and control strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the formulation of a mathematical model to simulate dengue disease transmission dynamics. It was conducted in a theoretical setting using differential equations, focusing on dengue fever and its associated factors without specific reference to real-world populations or data.
analysis.methods: The model was developed using a nonlinear system of differential equations, and the stability of equilibria was analyzed through Lyapunov stability theory and LaSalle's invariance principle. The study also included the formulation of an optimal control problem to evaluate preventive measures and interventions.
analysis.main_results: The model demonstrated classical threshold behavior, with the disease-free equilibrium being locally and globally asymptotically stable when the basic reproduction number is less than one. When the basic reproduction number exceeds one, the endemic equilibrium is globally asymptotically stable under certain conditions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the results as evidence of the model's ability to predict dengue disease dynamics based on the basic reproduction number. The novelty lies in the application of optimal control theory to evaluate interventions for dengue disease transmission.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of mathematical models for dengue disease surveillance and the evaluation of control strategies such as vaccination and insecticide treatment. They provide a theoretical basis for understanding disease spread and intervention effectiveness.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to theoretical modeling and does not include empirical data or real-world validation. The evidence is derived from mathematical analysis and simulations, which may not fully capture the complexities of dengue disease transmission in real populations. The confidence in the results is moderate due to the abstract-only nature of the evidence.

The findings provide a theoretical framework for understanding dengue disease dynamics and evaluating control strategies. However, the study is limited to theoretical analysis and lacks empirical validation, resulting in moderate confidence in the results.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过非线性微分方程模型模拟登革热的传播动力学,并通过非线性微分方程系统理解其全球特性。该研究针对改进数学框架以分析登革热传播和控制策略的需求进行了探讨。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及建立一个数学模型以模拟登革热传播动力学。该研究在理论环境中进行,使用微分方程,专注于登革热及其相关因素,而没有具体参考现实世界的人群或数据。
elements_zh.methods: 该模型通过非线性微分方程系统进行构建,利用李雅普诺夫稳定性理论和拉塞尔不变性原理分析平衡点的稳定性。研究还包括构建一个最优控制问题以评估登革热的预防措施和干预手段。
elements_zh.main_results: 该模型展示了经典的阈值行为,当基本再生数小于1时,无病平衡点在局部和全局上都是渐近稳定的。当基本再生数超过1时,在某些条件下,地方性平衡点在全局上是渐近稳定的。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将结果解释为模型能够基于基本再生数预测登革热动力学的证据。其新颖之处在于将最优控制理论应用于评估登革热传播的干预措施。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为登革热监测的数学模型开发以及评估控制策略(如疫苗接种和杀虫剂治疗)提供信息。它们为理解疾病传播和干预措施的有效性提供了理论基础。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于理论建模,未包含实证数据或现实世界验证。证据来源于数学分析和模拟,可能无法完全反映登革热传播在真实人群中的复杂性。由于证据仅基于摘要,结果的可信度中等。

We prove that when the basic reproduction number is less than one, the disease-free equilibrium is locally and globally asymptotically stable and when the basic reproduction number is greater than one the endemic equilibrium is globally asymptotically stable under certain conditions. The stability of equilibria is derived through the use of Lyapunov stability theory and LaSalle's invariance principle. In addition we formulate an optimal control problem involving preventive measures, the investment in vaccination of susceptible humans and the investment related to insecticide treatment. Numerical simulations are provided to illustrate the theoretical results.
papers.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中,我们制定了一个非线性微分方程组,对 登革热 的 传播 动力学进行建模。该模型表现出经典的阈值行为。我们证明,当基本再生数小于 1 时,无病平衡局部和全局渐近稳定;当基本再生数大于 1 时,地方性平衡在一定条件下全局渐近稳定。平衡的稳定性是通过利用李雅普诺夫稳定性理论和拉萨尔不变原理推导出来的。此外,我们还制定了一个最优控制问题,涉及预防措施、易感人群疫苗接种的投资以及与杀虫剂治疗相关的投资。提供数值模拟来说明理论结果。
papers.summary_zh: 在这项工作中,我们制定了一个非线性微分方程组,对 登革热 的 传播 动力学进行建模。该模型表现出经典的阈值行为。我们证明,当基本再生数小于 1 时,无病平衡局部和全局渐近稳定;当基本再生数大于 1 时,地方性平衡在一定条件下全局渐近稳定。平衡的稳定性是通过利用李雅普诺夫稳定性理论和拉萨尔不变原理推导出来的。此外,我们还制定了一个最优控制问题,涉及预防措施、易感人群疫苗接种的投资以及与杀虫剂治疗相关的投资。提供数值模拟来说明理论结果。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过非线性微分方程模型模拟登革热的传播动力学,并通过非线性微分方程系统理解其全球特性。该研究针对改进数学框架以分析登革热传播和控制策略的需求进行了探讨。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及建立一个数学模型以模拟登革热传播动力学。该研究在理论环境中进行,使用微分方程,专注于登革热及其相关因素,而没有具体参考现实世界的人群或数据。
analysis_zh.methods: 该模型通过非线性微分方程系统进行构建,利用李雅普诺夫稳定性理论和拉塞尔不变性原理分析平衡点的稳定性。研究还包括构建一个最优控制问题以评估登革热的预防措施和干预手段。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该模型展示了经典的阈值行为,当基本再生数小于1时,无病平衡点在局部和全局上都是渐近稳定的。当基本再生数超过1时,在某些条件下,地方性平衡点在全局上是渐近稳定的。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将结果解释为模型能够基于基本再生数预测登革热动力学的证据。其新颖之处在于将最优控制理论应用于评估登革热传播的干预措施。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为登革热监测的数学模型开发以及评估控制策略(如疫苗接种和杀虫剂治疗)提供信息。它们为理解疾病传播和干预措施的有效性提供了理论基础。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于理论建模,未包含实证数据或现实世界验证。证据来源于数学分析和模拟,可能无法完全反映登革热传播在真实人群中的复杂性。由于证据仅基于摘要,结果的可信度中等。

papers.full_text: Abstract Despite advances in disease monitoring, genomic surveillance of dengue virus (DENV) strains remains limited and regionally confined. The Phase 2 clinical trial (NCT05201794) of mosnodenvir prophylaxis conducted in endemic regions of Asia-Pacific and Latin America (2023–2024) provided a unique resource to assess genomic diversity of circulating DENVs. The study involved 411 dengue index cases (ICs). DENV serotypes were determined using RT-PCR. Whole-genome sequencing was conducted for a subset of ICs (n = 150) representing DENV serotypes observed over time at 30 sites across 7 countries. Cocirculation of all four DENV serotypes was observed in both Latin America and Asia-Pacific regions. Overall, DENV-1 was the predominant serotype (51.1%), with significant geographical variations in genotype distribution: DENV-1 genotype V in Latin America versus genotypes I and IV in the Asia-Pacific region. We identified increased circulation of DENV-3 and DENV-4 strains in Latin America during 2023–2024. Time-resolved phylogenetic analyses show that the study captured a broad cross-section of contemporary DENV diversity circulating across Latin America and the Asia-Pacific region during 2023–2024. Our findings stress the importance of genomic surveillance for public health preparedness to mitigate dengue risk, highlighting a mosaic of local lineages and frequent virus (re)-introductions, which may trigger new epidemics. elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究捕捉了2023–2024年间拉丁美洲和亚太地区广泛存在的当代DENV多样性,突出了DENV 进化的动态特性及其传播模式。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了基因组监测对于公共卫生准备的重要性,以减轻登革热风险,特别是在那些频繁出现病毒(再)引入的地区,这可能会引发新的疫情。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其关注的是临床试验人群,这可能无法完全代表一般人群中DENV的传播情况。由于数据的观察性质,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Dengue among febrile patients in Ghana: prevalence and facility-level variation in a multisite surveillance study
papers.abstract: Introduction: Dengue is under-recognized in Ghana, where laboratory testing is limited. We estimated dengue NS1 and/or IgM positivity among febrile patients and described geographical, temporal, and demographic variation. Methodology: We conducted cross-sectional surveillance among consenting febrile patients aged [≥]1 year at six public facilities in Greater Accra, Bono East, and Upper West between August 2023 and July 2025. We randomly selected one region within each of three ecological strata and selected facilities with high febrile-case volumes. We approached and recruited consecutive eligible patients. We tested serum for dengue NS1 antigen and IgM antibody by ELISA; positive NS1 samples underwent RT-PCR and serotyping. We estimated proportions with 95% confidence intervals (CI) and used logistic regression to examine adjusted associations. Results: Among 2,936 participants, 204 were NS1- and/or IgM-positive (6.95%; 95% CI, 6.05-7.93%): 31 were NS1-only, 161 IgM-only, and 12 dual-positive. Prevalence ranged from 3.88% (95% CI, 2.19-6.31%) at Kintampo to 12.32% (9.56-15.55%) at Atebubu, both in Bono East. Adjusted odds increased with age (aOR per five years, 1.09; 95% CI, 1.05-1.14). Eight of 43 NS1-positive samples contained dengue RNA: five DENV-1 from Bono East and three DENV-3 from Upper West. There was no clear rainy-dry season difference. Conclusions: Dengue NS1 and/or IgM were detected among febrile patients at all six facilities, and RT-PCR confirmed circulation of DENV-1 and DENV-3. These findings support including dengue in febrile illness evaluation and strengthening laboratory-supported surveillance in Ghana. Keywords: dengue, febrile illness, NS1 antigen, IgM, DENV-1, DENV-3, Ghana
authors: Marianne A. B. van der Sande

A cross-sectional surveillance was conducted at six public facilities in Greater Accra, Bono East, and Upper West between August 2023 and July 2025, involving 2,936 participants. papers.title: Epidemiología del dengue en Santo Domingo 2021-2025
papers.abstract: Objetivo: Analizar el comportamiento temporal de las notificaciones de dengue en la provincia de Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas durante 2021–2025, a fin de identificar sus variaciones semanales y anuales. Metodología: Se realizó un estudio observacional, descriptivo y retrospectivo, con diseño ecológico de serie temporal, basado en registros epidemiológicos agregados. Los datos se organizaron por año y semana epidemiológica en Microsoft Excel y se procesaron mediante IBM SPSS Statistics, versión 27, utilizando estadística descriptiva. Además, las semanas se agruparon en cuatro bloques operativos: SE 1–13, SE 14–26, SE 27–39 y SE 40–53. Resultados: Se analizaron 15.744 notificaciones de dengue. En 2023 se observó la mayor concentración semanal, principalmente entre las semanas epidemiológicas 28 y 46; en 2024, las frecuencias más elevadas se registraron durante la primera mitad del año. La distribución anual mostró que 2023 concentró 6.312 notificaciones (40,09 %) y 2024, 5.890 (37,41 %), que representaron conjuntamente el 77,50 % del total. En 2025 se registraron 1.385 notificaciones, cifra que representó una reducción del 76,49 % respecto de 2024. Conclusiones: Las notificaciones presentaron variaciones temporales importantes, con una mayor concentración en 2023 y 2024. Los hallazgos aportaron una referencia descriptiva para el seguimiento epidemiológico provincial y la planificación de acciones de vigilancia y prevención. Se recomendó incorporar variables climáticas, entomológicas, virológicas y socioambientales en futuras investigaciones.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to analyze the temporal behavior of dengue notifications in the province of Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas from 2021 to 2025 to identify weekly and annual variations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective, descriptive, and observational ecological time series study was conducted based on aggregated epidemiological records.
analysis.methods: Data were organized by year and epidemiological week in Microsoft Excel and processed using IBM SPSS Statistics, version 27, with descriptive statistics.
analysis.main_results: A total of 15,744 dengue notifications were analyzed. The highest weekly concentration was observed in 2023, mainly between epidemiological weeks 28 and 46; in 2024, the highest frequencies were recorded during the first half of the year. The annual distribution showed that 2023 had 6,312 notifications (40.09%) and 2024, 5,890 (37.41%), which together represented 77.50% of the total. In 2025, 1,385 notifications were recorded, a 76.49% reduction from 2024.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings provided a descriptive reference for provincial epidemiological monitoring and the planning of surveillance and prevention actions. It was recommended to incorporate climatic, entomological, virological, and socio-environmental variables in future research.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study's findings can inform the surveillance and planning of actions for dengue prevention and control in the province.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the retrospective nature and the reliance on aggregated data, which may limit the generalizability of the findings. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed dengue notifications in Santo Domingo de los Tsáchilas from 2021 to 2025, identifying weekly and annual variations. The highest concentrations were observed in 2023 and 2024, with a significant reduction in 2025. The findings provide a reference for surveillance and prevention.

papers.title: Foundation models capture human and environmental context to improve dengue forecasting
papers.abstract: Accurate and timely probabilistic dengue forecasts can support public health preparedness, but producing reliable forecasts across locations and time horizons remains challenging. We evaluated five statistical, machine-learning, deep-learning, and foundation-model approaches for forecasting monthly reported dengue cases across 5,570 Brazilian municipalities at 1-, 3-, 6- and 12-month horizons, with forecasts backtested from January 2020 to August 2025. The time-series foundation model TimesFM maintained comparatively stable probabilistic forecast performance at longer horizons, while most other models showed declining performance. We then tested whether spatial representations of human and environmental context from a Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM) could improve forecasts through post-hoc residual adjustment. PDFM adjustment improved mean probabilistic forecast performance, measured by the Weighted Interval Score (WIS), in 19 of 20 model-horizon combinations, although the magnitude and frequency of improvements varied across models, horizons and municipalities. The largest improvements were observed for N-BEATS, including a reduction in mean WIS of 1.13 at the six-month horizon (95% CI [0.84, 1.48]; Diebold-Mariano p < 0.0001), with improvements also observed for XGBoost. The proportion of forecasts improved by PDFM generally increased with locally reported dengue case counts, although this relationship varied between models. Covariate selection, spatial fitting and forecast aggregation strategies showed strong model-dependent effects, while monthly model retraining provided no consistent advantage in the settings evaluated. Together, these findings highlight the potential of pretrained representations for dengue forecasting, with benefits dependent on forecasting architecture, horizon and modelling configuration.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of various forecasting models, including foundation models, in predicting monthly dengue cases across 5,570 Brazilian municipalities. The research highlighted the challenges of producing reliable forecasts across different time horizons and locations. The time-series foundation model TimesFM showed stable performance at longer horizons, while most other models declined. The study tested whether spatial representations of human and environmental context from a Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM) could improve forecasts through post-hoc residual adjustment. PDFM adjustment improved mean probabilistic forecast performance, measured by the Weighted Interval Score (WIS), in 19 of 20 model-horizon combinations. The largest improvements were observed for N-BEATS, with a mean WIS reduction of 1.13 at the six-month horizon. The findings suggest that pretrained representations can enhance dengue forecasting, with benefits depending on the forecasting architecture, horizon, and modeling configuration. However, the study noted that covariate selection, spatial fitting, and forecast aggregation strategies had strong model-dependent effects, and monthly model retraining did not consistently improve outcomes. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the study's focus on model performance and the absence of direct biological or clinical data on dengue virus.

papers.title_zh: 基础模型捕捉人类和环境背景以提高登革热预测能力
papers.source_body_en: Accurate and timely probabilistic dengue forecasts can support public health preparedness, but producing reliable forecasts across locations and time horizons remains challenging. We evaluated five statistical, machine-learning, deep-learning, and foundation-model approaches for forecasting monthly reported dengue cases across 5,570 Brazilian municipalities at 1-, 3-, 6- and 12-month horizons, with forecasts backtested from January 2020 to August 2025. The time-series foundation model TimesFM maintained comparatively stable probabilistic forecast performance at longer horizons, while most other models showed declining performance. We then tested whether spatial representations of human and environmental context from a Population Dynamics Foundation Model (PDFM) could improve forecasts through post-hoc residual adjustment. PDFM adjustment improved mean probabilistic forecast performance, measured by the Weighted Interval Score (WIS), in 19 of 20 model-horizon combinations, although the magnitude and frequency of improvements varied across models, horizons and municipalities. The largest improvements were observed for N-BEATS, including a reduction in mean WIS of 1.13 at the six-month horizon (95% CI [0.84, 1.48]; Diebold-Mariano p < 0.0001), with improvements also observed for XGBoost. The proportion of forecasts improved by PDFM generally increased with locally reported dengue case counts, although this relationship varied between models. Covariate selection, spatial fitting and forecast aggregation strategies showed strong model-dependent effects, while monthly model retraining provided no consistent advantage in the settings evaluated. Together, these findings highlight the potential of pretrained representations for dengue forecasting, with benefits dependent on forecasting architecture, horizon and modelling configuration.

papers.title: DISTRIBUIÇÃO ESPACIAL E TEMPORAL DA DENGUE EM CRIANÇAS E ADOLESCENTES EM SANTA CATARINA (2021–2025): SUBSÍDIOS PARA AÇÕES DE EDUCAÇÃO EM SAÚDE NO AMBIENTE ESCOLAR
papers.abstract: O ano de 2024 marcou a maior epidemia de dengue já registrada no país, com repercussão expressiva em Santa Catarina. Objetivo: analisar a distribuição espacial e temporal dos casos prováveis de dengue em crianças e adolescentes residentes em Santa Catarina, de 2021 a 2025. Método: estudo descritivo, quantitativo e retrospectivo, com dados secundários e agregados por município, obtidos junto ao CIEGES-SC, referentes à faixa etária escolar (5-19 anos), e dados populacionais do IBGE (Censo 2022). Calculou-se a incidência em relação ao total de casos no Estado, por faixa etária e por macrorregião de saúde. Resultados: foram registrados 109.918 (19,0%) casos na faixa etária de 5 a 19 anos. O ano de 2024 concentrou o maior número de notificações, com incidência estadual de 4.396,9 casos por 100/mil/hab. As faixas de 5 a 9 anos (24,7%) e 15 a 17 anos (24,0%) foram as mais acometidas. As macrorregiões do Planalto Norte e Nordeste e do Vale do Itajaí concentraram, respectivamente, 35,3% e 34,3% dos casos. Conclusão: a dengue acometeu de forma heterogênea crianças e adolescentes catarinenses, com concentração temporal em 2024 e em macrorregiões específicas, o que reforça a necessidade de estratégias de educação em saúde direcionadas ao ambiente escolar.
papers.journal: Revista Ibero-Americana de Humanidades, Ciências e Educação

analysis.study_design_and_population: Trata-se de um estudo descritivo, quantitativo e retrospectivo, utilizando dados secundários e agregados por município de crianças e adolescentes residentes em Santa Catarina, na faixa etária de 5 a 19 anos, entre 2021 e 2025.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the spatial and temporal distribution of dengue cases in children and adolescents in Santa Catarina, Brazil, from 2021 to 2025. It aimed to provide insights for health education strategies in schools. The research used secondary data from CIEGES-SC and IBGE's 2022 census, aggregating cases by municipality and age group. Results showed that 19.0% of dengue cases occurred in children and adolescents, with 2024 being the peak year and the highest incidence rate of 4,396.9 cases per 100,000 inhabitants. The age groups 5-9 years and 15-17 years were most affected, and the Planalto Norte, Nordeste, and Vale do Itajaí macroregions had the highest case concentrations. The authors concluded that the heterogeneity in dengue distribution among children and adolescents highlights the need for targeted health education in schools. The study's findings are based on aggregated data, which may limit their precision and generalizability, but they provide valuable insights for public health interventions.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究为描述性、定量和回顾性研究,使用来自圣卡塔琳娜州市镇汇总的次级数据,涵盖2021年至2025年间居住在该州、年龄在5至19岁之间的儿童和青少年。
elements_zh.methods: 数据来自CIEGES-SC和IBGE 2022年人口普查,计算了各年龄段和各卫生大区的病例发病率。

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,登革热在儿童和青少年中的病例分布具有异质性,时间上集中在2024年,某些卫生大区尤为突出,这表明需要在学校环境中实施针对性的健康教育策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 登革热病例的空间与时间分布可为学校环境中的流行病学监测和健康教育行动提供信息,有助于在易感人群中预防和控制该疾病。

papers.full_text: Các yếu tố khí hậu và ngưỡng đơn giản cho cảnh báo sớm sốt xuất huyết Dengue tại Việt Nam: góc nhìn One Health “Climatic determinants” and simple thresholds for dengue early warning in Vietnam: a One Health perspective Thông tin về tác giả: Nguyễn Khởi Quân1,2, Andrew W. Taylor-Robinson1,3 Đơn vị công tác: 1Viện Khoa học Sức khỏe, Trường Đại học VinUni, Hà Nội; 2Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, Hoa Kỳ; 3Center for Global Health, University of Pennsylvania, Hoa Kỳ Thông tin liên hệ: Email: quan.nk@vinuni.edu.vn · Địa chỉ: Trường Đại học VinUni, Vinhomes Ocean Park, Hà Nội · Bài gốc: Science in One Health 2026;5:100159 ĐẶT VẤN ĐỀ / MỤC TIÊU NGHIÊN CỨU ĐỐI TƯỢNG – PHƯƠNG PHÁP NGHIÊN CỨU TÓM TẮT / ABSTRACT KẾT QUẢ KẾT LUẬN & ĐỀ XUẤT TÀI LIỆU THAM KHẢO TRIỂN LÃM POSTER KHOA HỌC DENGUE IN ACTION SỐT XUẤT HUYẾT DENGUE: ỨNG DỤNG KHOA HỌC VÀO THỰC TIỄN HƯỚNG TỚI MỤC TIÊU QUẢN LÝ TOÀN DIỆN HỘI NGHỊ SỐT XUẤT HUYẾT DENGUE NĂM 2026 DENGUE SUMMIT 2026 Sốt xuất huyết Dengue (SXHD) tại Việt Nam đang chuyển từlưu hành theo mùa sang bất ổn do khí hậu chi phối; cảnh báo dựa trên sốca trung bình 5 năm gây báo động giảvà bỏsót dịch. Tổng quan ngắn này đúc kết 10 ngưỡng khí hậu (nhiệt độ, mưa, hạn hán, nắng nóng, El Niño) với thời gian báo trước tới 6 tháng, có giá trịkhác nhau theo vùng, và đềxuất hệthống cảnh báo sớm kết hợp theo tiếp cận Một sức khỏe. Dengue in Vietnam is shifting from predictable seasonality to climate-driven instability, and early warning based on five-year case averages yields false alarms and missed outbreaks. This mini-review distills ten climatic thresholds (temperature, rainfall, drought, heatwaves, El Niño) with lead times of up to six months that vary by region, and proposes a hybrid One Health early warning system. Đặt vấn đề • Nóng lên toàn cầu, đô thị hóa và cực đoan thủy văn phá vỡ tính mùa của SXHD; dịch lan lên phía Bắc và vùng cao (dịch lớn 2019, 2022, 2024) [1–3]. • Ngưỡng cảnh báo theo trung bình 5 năm + 2 độ lệch chuẩn ngày càng sai: bỏ sót dịch sau năm dịch lớn, báo động giả sau COVID-19 [1,3]. Mục tiêu • Đúc kết các ngưỡng khí hậu đơn giản, có cơ sở sinh học, và đề xuất mô hình cảnh báo sớm kết hợp vận hành được ở tuyến cơ sở. • Thiết kế: tổng quan ngắn (mini-review) dạng tường thuật. • Đối tượng: nghiên cứu đã công bố về khí hậu – SXHD, chủ yếu tại Việt Nam và Đông Nam Á, kèm thực nghiệm trên muỗi Aedes. • Trích xuất: ngưỡng, chiều hướng nguy cơ, cơ chế, thời gian báo trước và vùng áp dụng của 10 tín hiệu khí hậu. • Đánh giá: 3 cách dự báo (siêu tổ hợp xác suất, kênh dịch tễ, học máy) theo lăng kính Một sức khỏe. Bằng chứng đã công bố Ngưỡng & thời gian báo trước Hiệu chỉnh theo vùng Cảnh báo sớm kết hợp Hình 1. Mười ngưỡng khí hậu tiềm năng cho cảnh báo sớm SXHD Tín hiệu khí hậu Ngưỡng / điều kiện Nguy cơ Cơ chế Thời gian báo trước Bắc Trung Nam Hành động ngay Chuẩn bị (1–6 tháng) Nhiệt độ trung bình [1,5,6] > 27 °C Rút ngắn ủ bệnh trong muỗi Tăng 1–3 tháng Nhiệt độ tối thiểu [6] > 22 °C Muỗi sống qua đông Duy trì 1–3 tháng – Biên độ nhiệt (DTR) lớn [7] Khi nhiệt độ TB 20–24 °C Trưa nóng, virus nhân lên nhanh Tăng 2–6 tuần – – Biên độ nhiệt (DTR) lớn [7] Khi nhiệt độ TB 28–30 °C Muỗi giảm sống sót, sinh sản Giảm Tức thì – – Nắng nóng [5] 5–7 ngày liên tiếp, nhiệt độ tối đa > bách phân vị 95 Muỗi chết, rồi bùng lại Tăng (trễ) 4–12 tuần Mưa vừa [5,8] 130–210 mm/tuần Thêm ổ chứa nước tạm thời Tăng 2–4 tuần Mưa cực đoan [5,8] scPDSI ≈ +4 Rửa trôi bọ gậy ngoài trời Giảm tạm thời 1–2 tuần – Hạn hán [1,5] scPDSI −3 đến −4 Trữ nước → ổ bọ gậy ổn định Tăng mạnh 4–12 tuần Số ngày khô liên tiếp [1,5] 15–20 ngày Báo trước hạn; kích hoạt trữ nước Tăng 2–8 tuần El Niño (ENSO) [2] NINO3.4 tăng 1 °C Ấm lên khu vực, dịch đồng loạt Tăng 2–6 tháng 0 1 tháng 3 tháng 6 tháng tín hiệu chính tín hiệu phụ không phân biệt – không đề cập tăng nguy cơ giảm nguy cơ Ngưỡng tiềm năng, cần hiệu chỉnh bằng số liệu giám sát địa phương trước khi áp dụng. Nguồn: Bảng 1, Quan & Taylor-Robinson (2026); thanh ngang = thời gian báo trước (1 tháng ≈ 4,35 tuần). scPDSI: chỉ số hạn Palmer tự hiệu chỉnh; NINO3.4: dị thường nhiệt độ mặt biển Thái Bình Dương. Ba tín hiệu “ngược trực giác” 1 Hạn hán làm tăng nguy cơ: trữ nước tạo ổ bọ gậy ổn định; dịch sau 1–3 tháng [1,5]. 2 Dịch vào tháng “mát”: biên độ nhiệt ngày–đêm lớn giúp virus nhân lên nhanh [7,9]. 3 Nắng nóng “bật lại”: muỗi chết trước, dịch đạt đỉnh 8–12 tuần sau [5]. 1Bổ sung, không thay thế: cảnh báo sớm kết hợp ba tầng TẦNG 1 · CHIẾN LƯỢC • Công cụ: mô hình xác suất, dự báo ENSO • Quy mô: quốc gia, tỉnh · 1–6 tháng • Dùng để: kế hoạch, ngân sách, dự trữ • Hạn chế: cần nhiều dữ liệu; kém khi có biến cố như COVID-19 [1,3] TẦNG 2 · CHIẾN THUẬT • Công cụ: ngưỡng khí hậu (Hình 1) • Quy mô: tuyến cơ sở · 2 tuần–3 tháng • 1 tín hiệu: hành động “không hối tiếc” • Nhiều tín hiệu: nâng mức cảnh báo TẦNG 3 · XÁC NHẬN • Công cụ: giám sát ca bệnh (kênh dịch tễ) • Dùng để: xác minh trước khi đáp ứng toàn diện • Hạn chế: ≈59% ca nhiễm không triệu chứng [10] • Nguyên tắc: tách khỏi nhiệm vụ cảnh báo [1,3] 3Lồng ghép Một sức khỏe (One Health) [1,4,8] Trữ nước hộ gia đình khi hạn hán Chăn nuôi đô thị: máng, phuy nước (cả Ae. albopictus) Wolbachia giảm hiệu quả khi nắng nóng Kháng hóa chất do thuốc BVTV nông nghiệp 4Thể chế hóa bằng SOP Tín hiệu nào? Hành động gì? Đơn vị nào? Khi nào? 2Phân tầng theo vùng MIỀN BẮC Nhiệt độTB, nhiệt độ tối thiểu, DTR MIỀN TRUNG El Niño, mưa bão, hạn hán MIỀN NAM Hạn hán, lượng mưa, El Niño (nhiệt độ không còn phân biệt) Việt Nam dài ≈1.650 km: một ngưỡng chung toàn quốc sẽ phân bổ sai nguồn lực [1,2,5]. Bản đồ minh họa (3 miền truyền thống). KẾT LUẬN Tín hiệu khí hậu là lời kêu gọi sẵn sàng, không phải lời dự báo: hãy hành động trước khi ca bệnh tăng. Quét mã đọc toàn văn 1. Gibb R, Colón-González FJ, Lan PT, et al. Nat Commun 2023;14:8179. 2. Tian Y, Xu Y, Liang Y, et al. Nat Commun 2025;16:8629. 3. Nguyen V-H, Tuyet-Hanh TT, Mulhall J, et al. PLoS Negl Trop Dis 2022;16:e0010509. 4. Quan NK, Taylor-Robinson AW. Nat Commun 2026;17:3222. 5. Ith S, Seposo X, Phy V, et al. PLoS Negl Trop Dis 2025;19:e0012649. 6. Akter R, Hu W, Gatton M, et al. Environ Res 2020;184:109222. 7. Carrington LB, Seifert SN, Willits NH, et al. J Med Entomol 2013;50:43–51. 8. Kumar P, Nguyen TH, Le PVV, et al. Explor Digit Health Technol 2023;1:17–27. 9. Taylor-Robinson AW. Chulalongkorn Med J 2025;69:61–2. 10. Asish PR, Dasgupta S, Rachel G, et al. Int J Infect Dis 2023;134:292–8. 11. Tuan DA. Trop Med Infect Dis 2024;9:250. Tài trợ: Trường Đại học VinUni (VUNI.2324.SG02). Lời cảm ơn: S. Leisz, P. Kumar, S. Fisher. Không có xung đột lợi ích.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Nghiên cứu nhằm giải quyết vấn đề về sự thay đổi tính mùa của sốt xuất huyết Dengue do biến đổi khí hậu, đô thị hóa và biến đổi thủy văn, đồng thời chỉ ra rằng các ngưỡng dự báo dựa trên trung bình 5 năm không còn hiệu quả trong việc phát hiện dịch bệnh.
analysis.study_design_and_population: Nghiên cứu là một tổng quan ngắn (mini-review) dựa trên các tài liệu đã công bố, tập trung vào mối liên hệ giữa các yếu tố khí hậu và sốt xuất huyết Dengue tại Việt Nam và Đông Nam Á, bao gồm cả các thí nghiệm trên muỗi Aedes.
analysis.methods: Nghiên cứu đã trích xuất các ngưỡng khí hậu, chiều hướng nguy cơ, cơ chế tác động và thời gian báo trước từ 10 tín hiệu khí hậu, đồng thời đánh giá ba phương pháp dự báo (siêu tổ hợp xác suất, kênh dịch tễ, học máy) thông qua lăng kính One Health.
analysis.main_results: Nghiên cứu xác định 10 ngưỡng khí hậu với thời gian báo trước lên đến 6 tháng, có sự khác biệt theo vùng. Một số tín hiệu như hạn hán, biên độ nhiệt lớn và nắng nóng có thể làm tăng hoặc giảm nguy cơ dịch, tùy thuộc vào điều kiện cụ thể.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Tác giả cho rằng các tín hiệu khí hậu là lời kêu gọi sẵn sàng, không phải là lời dự báo chính xác, và đề xuất một hệ thống cảnh báo sớm kết hợp ba tầng để cải thiện khả năng ứng phó với dịch bệnh.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Kết quả có thể hỗ trợ thiết kế hệ thống cảnh báo sớm hiệu quả hơn, điều chỉnh nguồn lực dựa trên vùng và điều kiện khí hậu, từ đó nâng cao khả năng kiểm soát dịch sốt xuất huyết Dengue trong bối cảnh biến đổi khí hậu.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Nghiên cứu có hạn chế trong việc cần hiệu chỉnh ngưỡng bằng dữ liệu giám sát địa phương trước khi áp dụng, đồng thời các phương pháp dự báo có thể không hiệu quả trong các biến cố lớn như dịch COVID-19. Dựa trên các bằng chứng đã công bố, đánh giá là ở mức trung bình.

analysis.summary_en: Nghiên cứu này tập trung vào việc phân tích các yếu tố khí hậu ảnh hưởng đến sự bùng phát sốt xuất huyết Dengue tại Việt Nam trong bối cảnh biến đổi khí hậu và đô thị hóa. Các tác giả đã tổng hợp 10 ngưỡng khí hậu với thời gian báo trước lên đến 6 tháng, có sự khác biệt theo vùng. Họ nhấn mạnh rằng các ngưỡng dựa trên trung bình 5 năm không còn đáng tin cậy do gây báo động giả và bỏ sót dịch. Nghiên cứu đề xuất một hệ thống cảnh báo sớm kết hợp ba tầng, bao gồm mô hình xác suất, ngưỡng khí hậu và giám sát dịch tễ, nhằm cải thiện khả năng ứng phó với dịch bệnh. Tuy nhiên, các ngưỡng cần được hiệu chỉnh bằng dữ liệu địa phương trước khi triển khai. Mặc dù nghiên cứu cung cấp bằng chứng từ các tài liệu đã công bố, nhưng có hạn chế trong việc áp dụng trong các tình huống bất thường như dịch COVID-19. Kết quả có thể hỗ trợ thiết kế các hệ thống cảnh báo sớm hiệu quả hơn, điều chỉnh nguồn lực theo vùng và điều kiện khí hậu, từ đó nâng cao khả năng kiểm soát dịch sốt xuất huyết Dengue.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在探讨气候变化、城市化和水文变化对登革热季节性变化的影响,并指出基于5年平均的预警阈值已不再有效于检测疫情。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究是一项基于已发表文献的简要综述,重点探讨气候因素与越南及东南亚地区登革热之间的关系,包括对埃及伊蚊的实验研究。
elements_zh.methods: 研究从10个气候信号中提取了气候阈值、风险趋势、作用机制和预警时间,同时通过One Health视角评估了三种预测方法(概率超组合、传播途径渠道、机器学习)的性能。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究确定了10个气候阈值,预测时间长达6个月,且存在地区差异。一些信号如干旱、温度振幅大和热浪可能会增加或减少疫情风险,具体取决于实际情况。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为气候信号是预警信号,而非准确预测,建议建立一个三层结合的早期预警系统以提高对疫情的应对能力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果可能有助于设计更有效的早期预警系统,根据地区和气候条件调整资源,从而提高在气候变化背景下的登革热疫情控制能力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究在应用前需要利用本地监测数据对阈值进行校正,同时预测方法可能在像 COVID-19 大流行这样的重大事件中效果不佳。基于已公布的证据,评估结果为中等水平。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Nghiên cứu nhằm giải quyết vấn đề về sự thay đổi tính mùa của sốt xuất huyết Dengue do biến đổi khí hậu, đô thị hóa và biến đổi thủy văn, đồng thời chỉ ra rằng các ngưỡng dự báo dựa trên trung bình 5 năm không còn hiệu quả trong việc phát hiện dịch bệnh.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: Nghiên cứu là một tổng quan ngắn (mini-review) dựa trên các tài liệu đã công bố, tập trung vào mối liên hệ giữa các yếu tố khí hậu và sốt xuất huyết Dengue tại Việt Nam và Đông Nam Á, bao gồm cả các thí nghiệm trên muỗi Aedes.
analysis_en.methods: Nghiên cứu đã trích xuất các ngưỡng khí hậu, chiều hướng nguy cơ, cơ chế tác động và thời gian báo trước từ 10 tín hiệu khí hậu, đồng thời đánh giá ba phương pháp dự báo (siêu tổ hợp xác suất, kênh dịch tễ, học máy) thông qua lăng kính One Health.
analysis_en.main_results: Nghiên cứu xác định 10 ngưỡng khí hậu với thời gian báo trước lên đến 6 tháng, có sự khác biệt theo vùng. Một số tín hiệu như hạn hán, biên độ nhiệt lớn và nắng nóng có thể làm tăng hoặc giảm nguy cơ dịch, tùy thuộc vào điều kiện cụ thể.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: Tác giả cho rằng các tín hiệu khí hậu là lời kêu gọi sẵn sàng, không phải là lời dự báo chính xác, và đề xuất một hệ thống cảnh báo sớm kết hợp ba tầng để cải thiện khả năng ứng phó với dịch bệnh.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Kết quả có thể hỗ trợ thiết kế hệ thống cảnh báo sớm hiệu quả hơn, điều chỉnh nguồn lực dựa trên vùng và điều kiện khí hậu, từ đó nâng cao khả năng kiểm soát dịch sốt xuất huyết Dengue trong bối cảnh biến đổi khí hậu.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: Nghiên cứu có hạn chế trong việc cần hiệu chỉnh ngưỡng bằng dữ liệu giám sát địa phương trước khi áp dụng, đồng thời các phương pháp dự báo có thể không hiệu quả trong các biến cố lớn như dịch COVID-19. Dựa trên các bằng chứng đã công bố, đánh giá là ở mức trung bình.

papers.source_body_en: This mini-review distills ten climatic thresholds (temperature, rainfall, drought, heatwaves, El Niño) with lead times of up to six months that vary by region, and proposes a hybrid One Health early warning system. • Thiết kế: tổng quan ngắn (mini-review) dạng tường thuật. Tổng quan ngắn này đúc kết 10 ngưỡng khí hậu (nhiệt độ, mưa, hạn hán, nắng nóng, El Niño) với thời gian báo trước tới 6 tháng, có giá trịkhác nhau theo vùng, và đềxuất hệthống cảnh báo sớm kết hợp theo tiếp cận Một sức khỏe. papers.title: Evolutionarily distinct dengue virus type 2 with a unique type-specific neutralization determinant
papers.abstract: Dengue viruses 1-4 (DENV1-4) mostly circulate in endemic cycles involving humans and Aedes mosquitoes. However, rare dengue outbreaks originate from non-human primates. These spillovers are caused by sylvatic virus genotypes that are closely related to endemic strains of the same serotype, but some are caused by strains that fall between the four canonical serotypes on phylogenetic trees. It is not clear whether these genotypic differences are reflected in corresponding antigenic differences. Here, we characterized the antigenic features of QML-22, a divergent strain most closely related to DENV2. On an antigenic map, QML-22 clustered with other globally representative DENV2 strains. QML-22 was not as well neutralized by antisera raised against endemic DENV2 and was better neutralized by antisera from DENV1, 3, and 4 infections than other strains of DENV2. QML-22 had a cluster of distinct amino acid residues in domain I of the envelope (E) protein, with only scattered point mutations elsewhere in the envelope. A potently neutralizing anti-DENV2 antibody that targets this site in domain I of the E protein, 3F9, had >1000-fold lower neutralization of QML-22 than other endemic DENV2 strains, whereas other cross-reactive and DENV2-specific antibodies neutralized QML-22 and endemic strains to similar titers. When antisera from non-human primates infected with QML-22 or DENV2 reference strain S16803 were depleted with the heterologous virions, homologous neutralization was unaffected but heterologous neutralization was reduced, suggesting homologous neutralization was due to distinct epitopes. Evolutionary analyses showed the 3F9 epitope was under relaxed selection pressure compared to other neutralizing epitopes and that QML-22 had unique amino acids in this epitope relative to the likely common ancestor of all DENV2. These findings provide insight into the antigenic diversification of DENV and the possible evolution of new serotypes.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate whether genotypic differences in dengue virus type 2 (DENV2) strains, such as QML-22, are associated with antigenic differences. This is important because understanding antigenic variation can inform vaccine development and surveillance strategies.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study characterized the antigenic features of QML-22, a divergent DENV2 strain, using antisera from infections with other DENV serotypes and non-human primates. The research focused on DENV2 and its relationship to other DENV serotypes.
analysis.methods: Antisera from non-human primates infected with QML-22 or DENV2 reference strain S16803 were used to assess neutralization. The 3F9 antibody, which targets a specific epitope in the envelope protein, was tested for its neutralization capacity against QML-22 and other DENV2 strains. Evolutionary analyses were conducted to compare the epitope's sequence across strains.
analysis.main_results: QML-22 was not as well neutralized by antisera against endemic DENV2 strains but was better neutralized by antisera from DENV1, 3, and 4 infections. The 3F9 epitope in QML-22 showed unique amino acids compared to the likely common ancestor of all DENV2 strains.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the antigenic differences in QML-22 are significant and may contribute to its distinct neutralization profile. This highlights the antigenic diversification of DENV2 and raises the possibility of new serotypes evolving.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide insights into the antigenic evolution of DENV2, which could inform the development of more effective vaccines and improve surveillance strategies for emerging strains.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract-only evidence, which may limit the depth of analysis. However, the findings are supported by direct experimental results and evolutionary comparisons, providing a moderate level of confidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the antigenic features of QML-22, a divergent dengue virus type 2 (DENV2) strain, and finds that it is not as well neutralized by antisera against endemic DENV2 strains but is better neutralized by antisera from DENV1, 3, and 4 infections. The 3F9 epitope in QML-22 shows unique amino acids compared to the likely common ancestor of all DENV2 strains. These findings suggest antigenic diversification within DENV2 and raise the possibility of new serotypes evolving. The study provides insights into the evolution of DENV2, which could inform vaccine development and surveillance strategies. However, the evidence is based on abstract-only data, which may limit the depth of analysis, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.
